verses.translit: taa kee tirasanaa kabahoo(n) na jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: - their thirst shall never depart. ||2||
The treacherous world-ocean is filled with terrible pain.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin kaise utaras paar ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, how can anyone cross over? ||3||
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved here and hereafter.
O Nanak, worship and adore the Name of the Lord. ||4||97||166||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The bearded emperor who struck down the poor,
has been burnt in the fire by the Supreme Lord God. ||1||
The Creator administers true justice.
He is the Saving Grace of His slaves. ||1||Pause||
In the beginning, and throughout the ages, His glory is manifest.
The slanderer died after contracting the deadly fever. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਿ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tin maariaa j rakhai na koi ||
verses.translation: He is killed, and no one can save him.
Here and hereafter, his reputation is evil. ||3||
The Lord hugs His slaves close in His Embrace.
Nanak seeks the Lord's Sanctuary, and meditates on the Naam. ||4||98||167||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The memorandum was proven to be false by the Lord Himself.
The sinner is now suffering in despair. ||1||
Those who have my Lord of the Universe as their support

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis kau jam nahee aavai neraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - death does not even approach them. ||1||Pause||
In the True Court, they lie;
the blind fools strike their own heads with their own hands. ||2||
Sickness afflicts those who commit sins;
God Himself sits as the Judge. ||3||
By their own actions, they are bound and gagged.

verses.original: ਦਰਬੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dharab giaa sabh jeea kai saathai ||4||
verses.translation: All their wealth is gone, along with their lives. ||4||
Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Court;
my Creator has preserved my honor. ||5||99||168||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੀਠ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jan kee dhoor man meeTh khaTaanee ||
verses.translation: The dust of the feet of the humble beings is so sweet to my mind.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poorab karam likhiaa dhur praanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Perfect karma is the mortal's pre-ordained destiny. ||1||Pause||
The mind is overflowing with the greasy dirt of egotistical pride.
With the dust of the feet of the Holy, it is scrubbed clean. ||1||
The body may be washed with loads of water,

verses.original: ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਤੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mail na utarai sudh na tehee ||2||
verses.translation: and yet its filth is not removed, and it does not become clean. ||2||
I have met the True Guru, who is merciful forever.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਭਉ ਕਾਲ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har simar simar kaaTiaa bhau kaal ||3||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I am rid of the fear of death. ||3||
Liberation, pleasures and worldly success are all in the Lord's Name.
With loving devotional worship, O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||4||100||169||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The Lord's slaves attain the highest status of life.
Meeting them, the soul is enlightened. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਕਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa simaran sun man kaanee ||
verses.translation: Those who listen with their mind and ears to the Lord's meditative remembrance,

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh paaveh har dhuaar paraanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: are blessed with peace at the Lord's Gate, O mortal. ||1||Pause||
Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Sustainer of the World.
O Nanak, gazing on the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am enraptured. ||2||101||170||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Peace and tranquility have come; the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has brought it.

verses.original: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taap paap binase mere bhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The burning sins have departed, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
With your tongue, continually chant the Lord's Name.
Disease shall depart, and you shall be saved. ||1||
Contemplate the Glorious Virtues of the Unfathomable Supreme Lord God.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be emancipated. ||2||
Sing the Glories of God each and every day;
your afflictions shall be dispelled, and you shall be saved, my humble friend. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: man bach karam prabh apanaa dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: In thought, word and deed, I meditate on my God.
Slave Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||102||171||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The Divine Guru has opened his eyes.

verses.original: ਭਰਮ ਗਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bharam ge pooran bhiee sev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Doubt has been dispelled; my service has been successful. ||1||Pause||
The Giver of joy has saved him from smallpox.
The Supreme Lord God has granted His Grace. ||1||
O Nanak, he alone lives, who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, drink deeply of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. ||2||103||172||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਓਹੁ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: dhan oh masatak dhan tere net ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that forehead, and blessed are those eyes;

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਓਇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhan oi bhagat jin tum sa(n)g het ||1||
verses.translation: blessed are those devotees who are in love with You. ||1||
Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how anyone find peace?

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa raam naam jas kaheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With your tongue, chant the Praises of the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Nanak is a sacrifice to those
who meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||2||104||173||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
You are my Advisor; You are always with me.
You preserve, protect and care for me. ||1||
Such is the Lord, our Help and Support in this world and the next.

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas kee paij rakhai mere bhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He protects the honor of His slave, O my Sibling of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਆਪਿ ਇਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: aagai aap ih thaan vas jaa kai ||
verses.translation: He alone exists hereafter; this place is in His Power.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar man har kau jaapai ||2||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, O my mind, chant and meditate on the Lord. ||2||
His honor is acknowledged, and he bears the True Insignia;
the Lord Himself issues His Royal Command. ||3||
He Himself is the Giver; He Himself is the Cherisher.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੦੫॥੧੭੪॥
verses.translit: nit nit naanak raam naam samaal ||4||105||174||
verses.translation: Continually, continuously, O Nanak, dwell upon the Name of the Lord. ||4||105||174||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
When the Perfect True Guru becomes merciful,
the Lord of the World abides in the heart forever. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raam ravat sadh hee sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, I have found eternal peace.

verses.original: ਮਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: miaa karee pooran har raiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Sovereign Lord, the Perfect King, has shown His Mercy to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jaa ke poore bhaag ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one whose destiny is perfect,
meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Everlasting Husband. ||2||106||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
He opens his loin-cloth, and spreads it out beneath him.
Like a donkey, he gulps down all that comes his way. ||1||
Without good deeds, liberation is not obtained.
The wealth of liberation is only obtained by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
He performs worship ceremonies, applies the ceremonial tilak mark to his forehead, and takes his ritual cleansing baths;
he pulls out his knife, and demands donations. ||2||
With his mouth, he recites the Vedas in sweet musical measures,
and yet he does not hesitate to take the lives of others. ||3||
Says Nanak, when God showers His Mercy,
even his heart becomes pure, and he contemplates God. ||4||107||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: thir ghar baisahu har jan piaare ||
verses.translation: Remain steady in the home of your own self, O beloved servant of the Lord.
The True Guru shall resolve all your affairs. ||1||Pause||
The Transcendent Lord has struck down the wicked and the evil.
The Creator has preserved the honor of His servant. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਸਭ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: baadhisaeh saeh sabh vas kar dheene ||
verses.translation: The kings and emperors are all under his power;
he drinks deeply of the most sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||2||
Meditate fearlessly on the Lord God.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this gift is given. ||3||
Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts;
he grasps the Support of God, his Lord and Master. ||4||108||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਜਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g raate bhaeh na jalai ||
verses.translation: One who is attuned to the Lord, shall not be burned in the fire.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਹੀ ਛਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g raate maiaa nahee chhalai ||
verses.translation: One who is attuned to the Lord, shall not be enticed by Maya.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਜਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g raate nahee ddoobai jalaa ||
verses.translation: One who is attuned to the Lord, shall not be drowned in water.
One who is attuned to the Lord, is prosperous and fruitful. ||1||
All fear is eradicated by Your Name.

verses.original: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bheTat sa(n)g har har gun gai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g raate miTai sabh chi(n)taa ||
verses.translation: One who is attuned to the Lord, is free of all anxieties.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੋ ਰਚੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har siau so rachai jis saadh kaa ma(n)taa ||
verses.translation: One who is attuned to the Lord, is blessed with the Mantra of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g raate jam kee nahee traas ||
verses.translation: One who is attuned to the Lord, is not haunted by the fear of death.
One who is attuned to the Lord, sees all his hopes fulfilled. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g raate dhookh na laagai ||
verses.translation: One who is attuned to the Lord, does not suffer in pain.
One who is attuned to the Lord, remains awake and aware, night and day.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g raataa sahaj ghar vasai ||
verses.translation: One who is attuned to the Lord, dwells in the home of intuitive peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਸੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g raate bhram bhau nasai ||3||
verses.translation: One who is attuned to the Lord, sees his doubts and fears run away. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g raate mat uootam hoi ||
verses.translation: One who is attuned to the Lord, has the most sublime and exalted intellect.
One who is attuned to the Lord, has a pure and spotless reputation.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੧੦੯॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tin kau bal jaiee || jin kau prabh meraa bisarat naahee ||4||109||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who do not forget my God. ||4||109||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Through sincere efforts, the mind is made peaceful and calm.
Walking on the Lord's Way, all pains are taken away.
Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes blissful.
Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, supreme bliss is obtained. ||1||
There is joy all around, and peace has come to my home.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, misfortune disappears. ||Pause||
My eyes are purified, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

verses.original: ਧਨਿ ਮਸਤਕ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹੀ ਪਰਸ ॥
verses.translit: dhan masatak charan kamal hee paras ||
verses.translation: Blessed is the forehead which touches His Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਸਫਲ ਇਹ ਕਾਂਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh kee Tahal safal ieh kaa(n)iaa ||
verses.translation: Working for the Lord of the Universe, the body becomes fruitful.
By the Grace of the Saints, I have obtained the supreme status. ||2||
The Lord is the Help and Support of His humble servant.
I have found peace, falling at the feet of His slaves.
When selfishness is gone, then one becomes the Lord Himself;
seek the Sanctuary of the treasure of mercy. ||3||
When someone finds the One he has desired,
then where should he go to look for Him?
I have become steady and stable, and I dwell in the seat of peace.
By Guru's Grace, Nanak has entered the home of peace. ||4||110||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The merits of taking millions of ceremonial cleansing baths,
the giving of hundreds of thousands, billions and trillions in charity

verses.original: ਜਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa man vasio har ko naam ||1||
verses.translation: - these are obtained by those whose minds are filled with the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Those who sing the Glories of the Lord of the World are totally pure.

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਨਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paap miTeh saadhoo saran dhiaal || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Their sins are erased, in the Sanctuary of the Kind and Holy Saints. ||Pause||
The merits of performing all sorts of austere acts of penance and self-discipline,
earning huge profits and seeing one's desires fulfilled
- these are obtained by chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with the tongue. ||2||
The merits of reciting the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas,
knowledge of the science of Yoga, spiritual wisdom and the pleasure of miraculous spiritual powers

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam japat prabh siau man maane ||3||
verses.translation: - these come by surrendering the mind and meditating on the Name of God. ||3||
The wisdom of the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord is incomprehensible.
Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and contemplating the Naam within our hearts,
O Nanak, God has showered His Mercy upon us. ||4||111||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance, I have found peace.
I have enshrined the Lotus Feet of the Guru within my heart. ||1||
The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, the Supreme Lord God, is perfect.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tiseh araadh meraa man dheeraa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Worshipping Him, my mind has found a lasting peace. ||Pause||
Night and day, I meditate on the Guru, and the Name of the Guru.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਂਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa te sidh bhe sagal kaa(n)m ||2||
verses.translation: Thus all my works are brought to perfection. ||2||
Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind has become cool and tranquil,
and the sinful mistakes of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||3||
Says Nanak, where is fear now, O Siblings of Destiny?

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੧੨॥
verses.translit: apane sevak kee aap paij rakhaiee ||4||112||
verses.translation: The Guru Himself has preserved the honor of His servant. ||4||112||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The Lord Himself is the Help and Support of His servants.
He always cherishes them, like their father and mother. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਉਬਰੈ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee saran ubarai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: In God's Sanctuary, everyone is saved.

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan karaavan pooran sach soi || rahaau ||
verses.translation: That Perfect True Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||Pause||
My mind now dwells in the Creator Lord.
My fears have been dispelled, and my soul has found the most sublime peace. ||2||
The Lord has granted His Grace, and saved His humble servant.
The sinful mistakes of so many incarnations have been washed away. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahan na jai prabh kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The Greatness of God cannot be described.
Servant Nanak is forever in His Sanctuary. ||4||113||

verses.translit: raag gauRee chetee mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Chaytee, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The power of the Lord is universal and perfect, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taa te birathaa na biaapai kaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So no pain can ever afflict me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo chitavai dhaas har maiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord's slave wishes, O mother,
the Creator Himself causes that to be done. ||1||
God causes the slanderers to lose their honor.
Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Fearless Lord. ||2||114||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੁਜ ਬਲ ਬੀਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗਰਤ ਪਰਤ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅੰਗੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhuj bal beer braham sukh saagar garat parat geh leh a(n)gureeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Brave and Powerful God, Ocean of Peace, I fell into the pit - please, take my hand. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨੈਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਹੀ ਆਰਤ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਰਟਤ ਪਿੰਗੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sravan na surat nain su(n)dhar nahee aarat dhuaar raTat pi(n)gureeaa ||1||
verses.translation: My ears do not hear, and my eyes are not beautiful. I am in such pain; I am a poor cripple, crying at Your Door. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਹਤਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dheenaa naath anaath karunaa mai saajan meet pitaa mahatareeaa ||
verses.translation: O Master of the poor and helpless, O Embodiment of Compassion, You are my Friend and Intimate, my Father and Mother.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੫॥
verses.translit: charan kaval hiradhai geh naanak bhai saagar sa(n)t paar utareeaa ||2||2||115||
verses.translation: Nanak holds tight to the Lord's Lotus Feet in his heart; thus the Saints cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||2||115||
Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦਯ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੀਤੁਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhay gusaiee meetulaa too(n) sa(n)g hamaarai baas jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord God, my Best Friend, please, abide with me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਰਹਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tujh bin gharee na jeevanaa dhirag rahanaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Without You, I cannot live, even for an instant, and my life in this world is cursed.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਿਆ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeea praan sukhadhaatiaa nimakh nimakh balihaar jee ||1||
verses.translation: O Breath of Life of the soul, O Giver of peace, each and every instant I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਸਤ ਅਲੰਬਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਰਤਹੁ ਉਧਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: hasat ala(n)ban dheh prabh garatahu udhar gopaal ||
verses.translation: Please, God, give me the Support of Your Hand; lift me up and pull me out of this pit, O Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: moh niragun mat thoreeaa too(n) sadh hee dheen dhiaal ||2||
verses.translation: I am worthless, with such a shallow intellect; You are always Merciful to the meek. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧੀ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa sukh tere sa(n)malaa kavan bidhee beechaar ||
verses.translation: What comforts of Yours can I dwell upon? How can I contemplate You?

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਦਾਸ ਹਿਤ ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saran samaiee dhaas hit uooche agam apaar ||3||
verses.translation: You lovingly absorb Your slaves into Your Sanctuary, O Lofty, Inaccessible and Infinite Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sagal padhaarath asaT sidh naam mahaa ras maeh ||
verses.translation: All wealth, and the eight miraculous spiritual powers are in the supremely sublime essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਕੇਸਵਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: suprasa(n)n bhe kesavaa se jan har gun gaeh ||4||
verses.translation: Those humble beings, with whom the beautifully-haired Lord is thoroughly pleased, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhapo too(n) mere praan adhaar ||
verses.translation: You are my mother, father, son and relative; You are the Support of the breath of life.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਜੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੧੬॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g naanak bhajai bikh tariaa sa(n)saar ||5||1||116||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak meditates on the Lord, and swims across the poisonous world-ocean. ||5||1||116||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਰਹੋਏ ਕੇ ਛੰਤ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਮਃ ੫
verses.translit: gauRee bairaagan rahoe ke chha(n)t ke ghar mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, Chhants Of Rehoay, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Is there anyone who will sing of the Beloved Lord?

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੂਖ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kaliaan sookh sach paavai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Surely, this will bring all pleasures and comforts. ||Pause||
The renunciate goes out into the woods, searching for Him.
But those who embrace love for the One Lord are very rare.
Those who find the Lord are very fortunate and blessed. ||1||
The Gods like Brahma and Sanak yearn for Him;
the Yogis, celibates and Siddhas yearn for the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiseh paraapat so har gun gaahai ||2||
verses.translation: One who is so blessed, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਿਨ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee saran jin bisarat naahee ||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten Him.
By great good fortune, one meets the Lord's Saint.
They are not subject to the cycle of birth and death. ||3||
Show Your Mercy, and lead me to meet You, O my Darling Beloved.
Hear my prayer, O Lofty and Infinite God;
Nanak begs for the Support of Your Name. ||4||1||117||
Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kavan gun praanapat milau meree maiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By what virtues can I meet the Lord of life, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰੂਪ ਹੀਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਹੀਨੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਨਿ ਦੂਰ ਤੇ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: roop heen budh bal heenee moh paradhesan dhoor te aaiee ||1||
verses.translation: I have no beauty, understanding or strength; I am a stranger, from far away. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਹਿਨ ਦਰਬੁ ਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਮਾਤੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naahin dharab na joban maatee moh anaath kee karahu samaiee ||2||
verses.translation: I am not wealthy or youthful. I am an orphan - please, unite me with Yourself. ||2||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਤ ਤਿਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat bhiee bairaagan prabh dharasan kau hau firat tisaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Searching and searching, I have become a renunciate, free of desire. I wander around, searching for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧੮॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal kirapaal prabh naanak saadhasa(n)g meree jalan bujhaiee ||4||1||118||
verses.translation: God is Compassionate, and Merciful to the meek; O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the fire of desire has been quenched. ||4||1||118||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh milabe kau preet man laagee ||
verses.translation: The loving desire to meet my Beloved has arisen within my mind.

verses.original: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕੋਊ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pai lagau moh karau benatee kouoo sa(n)t milai baddabhaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I touch His Feet, and offer my prayer to Him. If only I had the great good fortune to meet the Saint. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਉ ਆਗੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: man arapau dhan raakhau aagai man kee mat moh sagal tiaagee ||
verses.translation: I surrender my mind to Him; I place my wealth before Him. I totally renounce my selfish ways.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਫਿਰਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਵਿਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo prabh kee har kathaa sunaavai anadhin firau tis pichhai viraagee ||1||
verses.translation: One who teaches me the Sermon of the Lord God - night and day, I shall follow Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬ ਕਰਮ ਅੰਕੁਰ ਜਬ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਸਿਕ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: poorab karam a(n)kur jab pragaTe bheTio purakh rasik bairaagee ||
verses.translation: When the seed of the karma of past actions sprouted, I met the Lord; He is both the Enjoyer and the Renunciate.

verses.original: ਮਿਟਿਓ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਮਿਲਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੯॥
verses.translit: miTio a(n)dher milat har naanak janam janam kee soiee jaagee ||2||2||119||
verses.translation: My darkness was dispelled when I met the Lord. O Nanak, after being asleep for countless incarnations, I have awakened. ||2||2||119||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਕਸੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਂਖ ॥
verses.translit: nikas re pa(n)khee simar har paa(n)kh ||
verses.translation: Come out, O soul-bird, and let the meditative remembrance of the Lord be your wings.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhoo saran gahu pooran raam ratan heeare sa(n)g raakh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meet the Holy Saint, take to His Sanctuary, and keep the perfect jewel of the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਕੂਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਸ ਪੰਕਜ ਅਤਿ ਤੀਖੵਣ ਮੋਹ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: bhram kee kooiee tirasanaa ras pa(n)kaj at teekhayen moh kee faas ||
verses.translation: Superstition is the well, thirst for pleasure is the mud, and emotional attachment is the noose, so tight around your neck.

verses.original: ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaaTanahaar jagat gur gobidh charan kamal taa ke karahu nivaas ||1||
verses.translation: The only one who can cut this is the Guru of the World, the Lord of the Universe. So let yourself dwell at His Lotus Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa gobi(n)dh prabh preetam dheenaa naath sunahu aradhaas ||
verses.translation: Bestow Your Mercy, O Lord of the Universe, O God, My Beloved, Master of the meek - please, listen to my prayer.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨੦॥
verses.translit: kar geh leh naanak ke suaamee jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tumaree raas ||2||3||120||
verses.translation: Take my hand, O Lord and Master of Nanak; my body and soul all belong to You. ||2||3||120||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har pekhan kau simarat man meraa ||
verses.translation: My mind yearns to behold the Lord in meditation.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aas piaasee chitavau dhin rainee hai koiee sa(n)t milaavai neraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I think of Him, I hope and thirst for Him, day and night; is there any Saint who may bring Him near me? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa karau dhaas dhaasan kee anik bhaa(n)t tis karau nihoraa ||
verses.translation: I serve the slaves of His slaves; in so many ways, I beg of Him.

verses.original: ਤੁਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਤੋਲੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਸਭੋ ਹੀ ਥੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tulaa dhaar tole sukh sagale bin har dharas sabho hee thoraa ||1||
verses.translation: Setting them upon the scale, I have weighed all comforts and pleasures; without the Lord's Blessed Vision, they are all totally inadequate. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੋ ਜਾਤ ਬਹੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh gaae gun saagar janam janam ko jaat bahoraa ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I sing the Praises of the Ocean of virtue; after countless incarnations, I have been released.

verses.original: ਆਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨੧॥
verses.translit: aanadh sookh bheTat har naanak janam kirataarath safal saveraa ||2||4||121||
verses.translation: Meeting the Lord, Nanak has found peace and bliss; his life is redeemed, and prosperity dawns for him. ||2||4||121||
Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kin bidh milai gusaiee mere raam rai ||
verses.translation: How may I meet my Master, the King, the Lord of the Universe?

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਇ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koiee aaisaa sa(n)t sahaj sukhadhaataa moh maarag dhei bataiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Is there any Saint, who can bestow such celestial peace, and show me the Way to Him? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar alakh na jaiee lakhiaa vich paRadhaa haumai paiee ||
verses.translation: The Unseen Lord is deep within the self; He cannot be seen; the curtain of egotism intervenes.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭੋ ਜਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਇਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh sabho jag soiaa ih bharam kahahu kiau jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: In emotional attachment to Maya, all the world is asleep. Tell me, how can this doubt be dispelled? ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਕਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ekaa sa(n)gat ikat gireh basate mil baat na karate bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The one lives together with the other in the same house, but they do not talk to one another, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ਓਹ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਠਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ek basat bin pa(n)ch dhuhele oh basat agochar Thaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Without the one substance, the five are miserable; that substance is in the unapproachable place. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾਲਾ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਉਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa girahu tin dheeaa taalaa ku(n)jee gur saupaiee ||
verses.translation: And the one whose home it is, has locked it up, and given the key to the Guru.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anik upaav kare nahee paavai bin satigur saranaiee ||3||
verses.translation: You may make all sorts of efforts, but it cannot be obtained, without the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin ke ba(n)dhan kaaTe satigur tin saadhasa(n)gat liv laiee ||
verses.translation: Those whose bonds have been broken by the True Guru, enshrine love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch janaa mil ma(n)gal gaiaa har naanak bhedh na bhaiee ||4||
verses.translation: The self-elect, the self-realized beings, meet together and sing the joyous songs of the Lord. Nanak, there is no difference between them, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam rai in bidh milai gusaiee ||
verses.translation: This is how my Sovereign Lord King, the Lord of the Universe, is met;

verses.original: ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਠਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨੨॥
verses.translit: sahaj bhiaa bhram khin meh naaThaa mil jotee jot samaiee ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||1||122||
verses.translation: celestial bliss is attained in an instant, and doubt is dispelled. Meeting Him, my light merges in the Light. ||1||Second Pause||1||122||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
I am intimate with Him;

verses.original: ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਬੀਠੁਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karee kirapaa dhiaal beeThulai satigur mujheh bataio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: granting His Grace, my Kind Beloved has told me of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸੁਆਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: jat kat dhekhau tat tat tum hee moh ih bisuaas hoi aaio ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there You are; I am totally convinced of this.

verses.original: ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਉ ਸੁਨਤੋ ਹੈ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kai peh karau aradhaas benatee jau sunato hai raghuraio ||1||
verses.translation: Unto whom should I pray? The Lord Himself hears all. ||1||

verses.original: ਲਹਿਓ ਸਹਸਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਤੋਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: lahio sahasaa ba(n)dhan gur tore taa(n) sadhaa sahaj sukh paio ||
verses.translation: My anxiety is over. The Guru has cut away my bonds, and I have found eternal peace.

verses.original: ਹੋਣਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਹਾ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: honaa saa soiee fun hosee sukh dhukh kahaa dhikhaio ||2||
verses.translation: Whatever shall be, shall be in the end; so where can pain and pleasure be seen? ||2||

verses.original: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਦਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd kaa eko Thaanaa gur paradhaa khol dhikhaio ||
verses.translation: The continents and the solar systems rest in the support of the One Lord. The Guru has removed the veil of illusion, and shown this to me.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ਤਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੈਠੈ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nau nidh naam nidhaan ik Thaiee tau baahar kaiThai jaio ||3||
verses.translation: The nine treasures of the wealth of the Name of the Lord are in that one place. Where else should we go? ||3||

verses.original: ਏਕੈ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਰਚਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: ekai kanik anik bhaat saajee bahu parakaar rachaio ||
verses.translation: The same gold is fashioned into various articles; just so, the Lord has made the many patterns of the creation.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਇਵ ਤਤੈ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak bharam gur khoiee hai iv tatai tat milaio ||4||2||123||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt; in this way, my essence merges into God's essence. ||4||2||123||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
This life is diminishing, day and night.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man gur mil kaaj savaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: karau bena(n)tee sunahu mere meetaa sa(n)t Tahal kee belaa ||
verses.translation: Listen, my friends, I beg of you: now is the time to serve the Saints!

verses.original: ਈਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਬਸਨੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa khaaT chalahu har laahaa aagai basan suhelaa ||1||
verses.translation: In this world, earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and hereafter, you shall dwell in peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਸਹਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: eih sa(n)saar bikaar sahase meh tario braham giaanee ||
verses.translation: This world is engrossed in corruption and cynicism. Only those who know God are saved.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਪੀਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiseh jagai peeaae har ras akath kathaa tin jaanee ||2||
verses.translation: Those who are awakened by the Lord to drink in this sublime essence, come to know the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਸੋਈ ਵਿਹਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau aae soiee vihaajhahu har gur te maneh baseraa ||
verses.translation: Purchase only that for which you have come into the world, and through the Guru, the Lord shall dwell within your mind.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nij ghar mahal paavahu sukh sahaje bahur na hoigo feraa ||3||
verses.translation: Within the home of your own inner being, you shall obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence with intuitive ease. You shall not be consigned again to the wheel of reincarnation. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee purakh bidhaate saradhaa man kee poore ||
verses.translation: O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, Primal Being, Architect of Destiny: please fulfill this yearning of my mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੪॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas ihee sukh maagai mo kau kar sa(n)tan kee dhoore ||4||3||124||
verses.translation: Nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||3||124||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Save me, O My Father God.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਸਭ ਗੁਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh niragun sabh gun tere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am worthless and without virtue; all virtues are Yours. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਏਕੁ ਗਰੀਬਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch bikhaadhee ek gareebaa raakhahu raakhanahaare ||
verses.translation: The five vicious thieves are assaulting my poor being; save me, O Savior Lord!

verses.original: ਖੇਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੰਤਾਵਹਿ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khedh kareh ar bahut sa(n)taaveh aaio saran tuhaare ||1||
verses.translation: They are tormenting and torturing me. I have come, seeking Your Sanctuary. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar haario anik bahu bhaatee chhoddeh katahoo(n) naahee ||
verses.translation: Trying all sorts of things, I have grown weary, but still, they will not leave me alone.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਤਾਕੀ ਓਟਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ek baat sun taakee oTaa saadhasa(n)g miT jaahee ||2||
verses.translation: But I have heard that they can be rooted out, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; and so I seek their Shelter. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa sa(n)t mile moh tin te dheeraj paiaa ||
verses.translation: In their Mercy, the Saints have met me, and from them, I have obtained satisfaction.

verses.original: ਸੰਤੀ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tee ma(n)t dheeo moh nirabhau gur kaa sabadh kamaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Saints have given me the Mantra of the Fearless Lord, and now I practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੀਤਿ ਲਏ ਓਇ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeet le oi mahaa bikhaadhee sahaj suhelee baanee ||
verses.translation: I have now conquered those terrible evil-doers, and my speech is now sweet and sublime.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak man bhiaa paragaasaa paiaa padh nirabaanee ||4||4||125||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Divine Light has dawned within my mind; I have obtained the state of Nirvaanaa. ||4||4||125||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
He is the Eternal King.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਬਸਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਡਰਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau sa(n)g tumaarai basate ih ddaran kahaa te aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Fearless Lord abides with you. So where does this fear come from? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਹਿ ਅਫਾਰੋ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਨਿਮਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: ek mahal too(n) hoh afaaro ek mahal nimaano ||
verses.translation: In one person, You are arrogant and proud, and in another, You are meek and humble.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਗਰੀਬਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek mahal too(n) aape aape ek mahal gareebaano ||1||
verses.translation: In one person, You are all by Yourself, and in another, You are poor. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬਕਤਾ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਖਲੁ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ek mahal too(n) pa(n)ddit bakataa ek mahal khal hotaa ||
verses.translation: In one person, you are a Pandit, a religious scholar and a preacher, and in another, You are just a fool.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜੁ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲੇਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ek mahal too(n) sabh kichh graahaj ek mahal kachhoo na letaa ||2||
verses.translation: In one person, You grab hold of everything, and in another, You accept nothing. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਖਿਲਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaaTh kee putaree kahaa karai bapuree khilaavanahaaro jaanai ||
verses.translation: What can the poor wooden puppet do? The Master Puppeteer knows everything.

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਭੇਖੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਸਾਜੁ ਆਨੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaisaa bhekh karaavai baajeegar oh taiso hee saaj aanai ||3||
verses.translation: As the Puppeteer dresses the puppet, so is the role the puppet plays. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: anik koTharee bahut bhaat kareeaa aap hoaa rakhavaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord has created the various chambers of assorted descriptions, and He Himself protects them.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤੈਸੈ ਰਹਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jaise mahal raakhai taisai rahanaa kiaa ih karai bichaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: As is that vessel in which the Lord places the soul, so does it dwell. What can this poor being do? ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin kichh keeaa soiee jaanai jin ieh sabh bidh saajee ||
verses.translation: The One who created the thing, understands it; He has fashioned all of this.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਾਜੀ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੨੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak apara(n)par suaamee keemat apune kaajee ||5||5||126||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Lord and Master is Infinite; He alone understands the value of His Creation. ||5||5||126||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਰਸੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd chhodd re bikhiaa ke rasooaa ||
verses.translation: Give them up - give up the pleasures of corruption;

verses.original: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰੇ ਬਾਵਰ ਗਾਵਰ ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਖੈ ਹਰਿਆਇਓ ਪਸੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aurajh rahio re baavar gaavar jiau kirakhai hariaaio pasooaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: you are entangled in them, you crazy fool, like an animal grazing in the green fields. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਾਜੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਸੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo jaaneh too(n) apune kaajai so sa(n)g na chaalai terai tasooaa ||
verses.translation: That which you believe to be of use to you, shall not go even an inch with you.

verses.original: ਨਾਗੋ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਗ ਸਿਧਾਸੀ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਗਰਸੂਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naago aaio naag sidhaasee fer firio ar kaal garasooaa ||1||
verses.translation: Naked you came, and naked you shall depart. You shall go round and round the cycle of birth and death, and you shall be food for Death. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੇ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਤਿਨਹੂੰ ਲਉ ਹਸੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: pekh pekh re kasu(n)bh kee leelaa raach maach tinahoo(n) lau hasooaa ||
verses.translation: Watching, watching the transitory dramas of the world, you are embroiled and enmeshed in them, and you laugh with delight.

verses.original: ਛੀਜਤ ਡੋਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਛੂਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chheejat ddor dhinas ar rainee jeea ko kaaj na keeno kachhooaa ||2||
verses.translation: The string of life is wearing thin, day and night, and you have done nothing for your soul. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਬਿਰਧਾਨੋ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਉਕਤੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨਸੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: karat karat iv hee biradhaano haario ukate tan kheenasooaa ||
verses.translation: Doing your deeds, you have grown old; your voice fails you, and your body has become weak.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਉਨਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਬਾਲਾ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੁਚ ਚਸੂਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau mohio un mohanee baalaa us te ghaTai naahee ruch chasooaa ||3||
verses.translation: You were enticed by Maya in your youth, and your attachment for it has not diminished, one little bit. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਐਸਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਤਜਿ ਗਰਬਸੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: jag aaisaa moh gureh dhikhaio tau saran pario taj garabasooaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has shown me that this is the way of the world; I have abandoned the dwelling of pride, and entered Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੂਆ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੨੭॥
verses.translit: maarag prabh ko sa(n)t bataio dhiraRee naanak dhaas bhagat har jasooaa ||4||6||127||
verses.translation: The Saint has shown me the Path of God; slave Nanak has implanted devotional worship and the Praise of the Lord. ||4||6||127||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Except for You, who is mine?
O my Beloved, You are the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kee bidh tum hee jaanee tum hee sajan suhele ||
verses.translation: You alone know the condition of my inner being. You are my Beautiful Friend.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sarab sukhaa mai tujh te paae mere Thaakur ageh atole ||1||
verses.translation: I receive all comforts from You, O my Unfathomable and Immeasurable Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਰੰਗਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: baran na saakau tumare ra(n)gaa gun nidhaan sukhadhaate ||
verses.translation: I cannot describe Your Manifestations, O Treasure of Excellence, O Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: agam agochar prabh abinaasee poore gur te jaate ||2||
verses.translation: God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible and Imperishable; He is known through the Perfect Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bhau kaaT ke'ee nihakeval jab te haumai maaree ||
verses.translation: My doubt and fear have been taken away, and I have been made pure, since my ego was conquered.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੋ ਚੂਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam maran ko chooko sahasaa saadhasa(n)gat dharasaaree ||3||
verses.translation: My fear of birth and death has been abolished, beholding Your Blessed Vision in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: charan pakhaar karau gur sevaa baar jaau lakh bareeaa ||
verses.translation: I wash the Guru's Feet and serve Him; I am a sacrifice to Him, 100,000 times.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਰੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੨੮॥
verses.translit: jeh prasaadh ih bhaujal tariaa jan naanak pria sa(n)g mireeaa ||4||7||128||
verses.translation: By His Grace, servant Nanak has crossed over this terrifying world-ocean; I am united with my Beloved. ||4||7||128||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Who can please You, except You Yourself?

verses.original: ਤੇਰੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tero roop sagal dhekh mohee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon Your Beauteous Form, all are entranced. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਗ ਪਇਆਲ ਮਿਰਤ ਭੂਅ ਮੰਡਲ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: surag piaal mirat bhooa ma(n)ddal sarab samaano ekai ohee ||
verses.translation: In the heavenly paradise, in the nether regions of the underworld, on the planet earth and throughout the galaxies, the One Lord is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਕਰਤ ਸਗਲ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਮਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਦੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: siv siv karat sagal kar joreh sarab miaa Thaakur teree dhohee ||1||
verses.translation: Everyone calls upon You with their palms pressed together, saying, ""Shiva, Shiva"". O Merciful Lord and Master, everyone cries out for Your Help. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੀਤਲੋਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan Thaakur naam tumaraa sukhadhaiee niramal seetalohee ||
verses.translation: Your Name, O Lord and Master, is the Purifier of sinners, the Giver of peace, immaculate, cooling and soothing.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਿਉ ਗਾਲ ਗਲੋਹੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੯॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan naanak vaddiaaiee sa(n)t tere siau gaal galohee ||2||8||129||
verses.translation: O Nanak, spiritual wisdom, meditation and glorious greatness come from dialogue and discourse with Your Saints. ||2||8||129||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Meet with me, O my Dear Beloved.
O God, whatever You do - that alone happens. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: anik janam bahu jonee bhramiaa bahur bahur dhukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Wandering around through countless incarnations, I endured pain and suffering in so many lives, over and over again.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tumaree kirapaa te maanukh dheh paiee hai dheh dharas har raiaa ||1||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, I obtained this human body; grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Sovereign Lord King. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: soiee hoaa jo tis bhaanaa avar na kin hee keetaa ||
verses.translation: That which pleases His Will has come to pass; no one else can do anything.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tumarai bhaanai bharam moh mohiaa jaagat naahee sootaa ||2||
verses.translation: By Your Will, enticed by the illusion of emotional attachment, the people are asleep; they do not wake up. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: binau sunahu tum praanapat piaare kirapaa nidh dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: Please hear my prayer, O Lord of Life, O Beloved, Ocean of mercy and compassion.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਾਥਹ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raakh leh pitaa prabh mere anaatheh kar pratipaalaa ||3||
verses.translation: Save me, O my Father God. I am an orphan - please, cherish me! ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no tumeh dhikhaio dharasan saadhasa(n)gat kai paachhai ||
verses.translation: You reveal the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, for the sake of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਛੈ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੩੦॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa dhoor dheh sa(n)tan kee sukh naanak ih baachhai ||4||9||130||
verses.translation: Grant Your Grace, and bless us with the dust of the feet of the Saints; Nanak yearns for this peace. ||4||9||130||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
I am a sacrifice to those

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai keval naam adhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: who take the Support of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਨੀਐ ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: mahimaa taa kee ketak ganeeaai jan paarabraham ra(n)g raate ||
verses.translation: How can I recount the praises of those humble beings who are attuned to the Love of the Supreme Lord God?

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh tinaa sa(n)g un samasar avar na dhaate ||1||
verses.translation: Peace, intuitive poise and bliss are with them. There are no other givers equal to them. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਸੇਈ ਆਏ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jagat udhaaran seiee aae jo jan dharas piaasaa ||
verses.translation: They have come to save the world - those humble beings who thirst for His Blessed Vision.

verses.original: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aun kee saran parai so tariaa sa(n)tasa(n)g pooran aasaa ||2||
verses.translation: Those who seek their Sanctuary are carried across; in the Society of the Saints, their hopes are fulfilled. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਪਰਉ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: taa kai charan parau taa jeevaa jan kai sa(n)g nihaalaa ||
verses.translation: If I fall at their Feet, then I live; associating with those humble beings, I remain happy.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੋਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhagatan kee ren hoi man meraa hoh prabhoo kirapaalaa ||3||
verses.translation: O God, please be merciful to me, that my mind might become the dust of the feet of Your devotees. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਵਧ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਘਾਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: raaj joban avadh jo dheesai sabh kichh jug meh ghaaTiaa ||
verses.translation: Power and authority, youth and age - whatever is seen in this world, all of it shall fade away.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੩੧॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan sadh navatan niramal ih naanak har dhan khaaTiaa ||4||10||131||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever new and immaculate. Nanak has earned this wealth of the Lord. ||4||10||131||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: jog jugat sun aaio gur te ||
verses.translation: I came to the Guru, to learn the Way of Yoga.

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mo kau satigur sabadh bujhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has revealed it to me through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: nau kha(n)dd pirathamee is tan meh raviaa nimakh nimakh namasakaaraa ||
verses.translation: He is contained in the nine continents of the world, and within this body; each and every moment, I humbly bow to Him.

verses.original: ਦੀਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿਓ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dheekhiaa gur kee mu(n)dhraa kaanee dhiraRio ek nira(n)kaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: I have made the Guru's Teachings my ear-rings, and I have enshrined the One Formless Lord within my being. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਚੇਲੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਏ ਇਕਤ੍ਰਾ ਏਕਸੁ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch chele mil bhe ikatraa ekas kai vas ke'ee ||
verses.translation: I have brought the five disciples together, and they are now under the control of the one mind.

verses.original: ਦਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਤਬ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਗੀ ਥੀਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhas bairaagan aagiaakaaree tab niramal jogee the'ee ||2||
verses.translation: When the ten hermits become obedient to the Lord, then I became an immaculate Yogi. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਰਮੁ ਜਰਾਇ ਚਰਾਈ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੇਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bharam jarai charaiee bibhootaa pa(n)th ek kar pekhiaa ||
verses.translation: I have burnt my doubt, and smeared my body with the ashes. My path is to see the One and Only Lord.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਸੋ ਕੀਨੀ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sahaj sookh so keenee bhugataa jo Thaakur masatak lekhiaa ||3||
verses.translation: I have made that intuitive peace my food; the Lord Master has written this pre-ordained destiny upon my forehead. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਹਾ ਆਸਨੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਸਿੰਗੀ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeh bhau naahee tahaa aasan baadhio si(n)gee anahat baanee ||
verses.translation: In that place where there is no fear, I have assumed my Yogic posture. The unstruck melody of His Bani is my horn.

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਡੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tat beechaar dda(n)ddaa kar raakhio jugat naam man bhaanee ||4||
verses.translation: I have made contemplation upon the essential reality my Yogic staff. The Love of the Name in my mind is my Yogic lifestyle. ||4||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਭੇਟੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa jogee vaddabhaagee bheTai maiaa ke ba(n)dhan kaaTai ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, such a Yogi is met, who cuts away the bonds of Maya.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਗ ਚਾਟੈ ॥੫॥੧੧॥੧੩੨॥
verses.translit: sevaa pooj karau tis moorat kee naanak tis pag chaaTai ||5||11||132||
verses.translation: Nanak serves and adores this wondrous person, and kisses his feet. ||5||11||132||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਨੂਪ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਧਿਆਇਲੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: anoop padhaarath naam sunahu sagal dhiaaile meetaa ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is an incomparably beautiful treasure. Listen, everyone, and meditate on it, O friends.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har aaukhadh jaa kau gur dheeaa taa ke niramal cheetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those, unto whom the Guru has given the Lord's medicine - their minds become pure and immaculate. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਧਕਾਰੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhakaar miTio teh tan te gur sabadh dheepak paragaasaa ||
verses.translation: Darkness is dispelled from within that body, in which the Divine Light of the Guru's Shabad shines.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhram kee jaalee taa kee kaaTee jaa kau saadhasa(n)gat bisavaiaasaa ||1||
verses.translation: The noose of doubt is cut away from those who place their faith in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਾਰੀਲੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੂ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: taareele bhavajal taaroo bikhaRaa bohith saadhoo sa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: The treacherous and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, in the boat of the Saadh Sangat.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pooran hoiee man kee aasaa gur bheTio har ra(n)gaa ||2||
verses.translation: My mind's desires are fulfilled, meeting the Guru, in love with the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naam khajaanaa bhagatee paiaa man tan tirapat aghaae ||
verses.translation: The devotees have found the treasure of the Naam; their minds and bodies are satisfied and satiated.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੩॥੧੨॥੧੩੩॥
verses.translit: naanak har jeeau taa kau dhevai jaa kau hukam manaae ||3||12||133||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Dear Lord gives it only to those who surrender to the Lord's Command. ||3||12||133||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਮੋਰੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa miaa kar praanapat more moh anaath saran prabh toree ||
verses.translation: Please be kind and compassionate, O Lord of my life; I am helpless, and I seek Your Sanctuary, God.

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop meh haath dhe raakhahu kachhoo siaanap ukat na moree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please, give me Your Hand, and lift me up, out of the deep dark pit. I have no clever tricks at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: karan karaavan sabh kichh tum hee tum samarath naahee an horee ||
verses.translation: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes - You are everything. You are All-powerful; there is no other than You.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਸੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਜਿਨ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tumaree gat mit tum hee jaanee se sevak jin bhaag mathoree ||1||
verses.translation: You alone know Your condition and extent. They alone become Your servants, upon whose foreheads such good destiny is recorded. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤੇ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: apune sevak sa(n)g tum prabh raate ot pot bhagatan sa(n)g joree ||
verses.translation: You are imbued with Your servant, God; Your devotees are woven into Your Fabric, through and through.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਚਾਹੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਓਹ ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: priau priau naam teraa dharasan chaahai jaise dhirasaT oh cha(n)dh chakoree ||2||
verses.translation: O Darling Beloved, they yearn for Your Name and the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, like the chakvee bird which longs to see the moon. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਸੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਕਈ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: raam sa(n)t meh bhedh kichh naahee ek jan kiee meh laakh karoree ||
verses.translation: Between the Lord and His Saint, there is no difference at all. Among hundreds of thousands and millions, there is scarcely one humble being.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਰਸਨ ਰਮੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kai heeaai pragaT prabh hoaa anadhin keeratan rasan ramoree ||3||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are illuminated by God, sing the Kirtan of His Praises night and day with their tongues. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਤਿ ਊਚੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tum samarath apaar at uooche sukhadhaate prabh praan adhoree ||
verses.translation: You are All-powerful and Infinite, the most lofty and exalted, the Giver of peace; O God, You are the Support of the breath of life.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਉਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗੋਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੩੪॥
verses.translit: naanak kau prabh keejai kirapaa un sa(n)tan kai sa(n)g sa(n)goree ||4||13||134||
verses.translation: Please show mercy to Nanak, O God, that he may remain in the Society of the Saints. ||4||13||134||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
O Saint, You are attuned to the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਓੜਿ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਹੁ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nibaeh leh mo kau purakh bidhaate oR pahuchaavahu dhaate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please stand my me, Architect of Destiny; please take me to my destination, Great Giver. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਤੁਮਾ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: tumaraa maram tumaa hee jaaniaa tum pooran purakh bidhaate ||
verses.translation: You alone know Your mystery; You are the Perfect Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਦੀਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raakhahu saran anaath dheen kau karahu hamaaree gaate ||1||
verses.translation: I am a helpless orphan - please keep me under Your Protection and save me. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਰਣ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਭਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: taran saagar bohith charan tumaare tum jaanahu apunee bhaate ||
verses.translation: Your Feet are the boat to carry us across the world-ocean; You alone know Your ways.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jis raakhahu sa(n)ge te te paar paraate ||2||
verses.translation: Those whom You keep protected, by Your Kindness, cross over to the other side. ||2||

verses.original: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਹਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: e'eet uoot prabh tum samarathaa sabh kichh tumarai haathe ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, God, You are All-powerful; everything is in Your Hands.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਚਲੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaisaa nidhaan dheh mo kau har jan chalai hamaarai saathe ||3||
verses.translation: Please give me that treasure, which will go along with me, O servant of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: niraguneeaare kau gun keejai har naam meraa man jaape ||
verses.translation: I am without virtue - please bless me with virtue, so that my mind might chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੩੫॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh naanak har bheTe man tan seetal dhraape ||4||14||135||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, Nanak has met the Lord; his mind and body are soothed and satisfied. ||4||14||135||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
I am intuitively absorbed in the Divine Lord.

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mo kau satigur bhe dhiaal dhev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Divine True Guru has become Merciful to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਟਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਕੀਓ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਤਨ ਟਹਲਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kaaT jevaree keeo dhaasaro sa(n)tan Tahalaio ||
verses.translation: Cutting away the halter, He has made me His slave, and now I work for the Saints.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਥੀਓ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek naam ko theeo poojaaree mo kau acharaj gureh dhikhaio ||1||
verses.translation: I have become a worshipper of the One Name; the Guru has shown me this amazing wonder. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: bhio pragaas sarab ujeeaaraa gur giaan maneh pragaTaio ||
verses.translation: The Divine Light has dawned, and everything is illuminated; the Guru has revealed this spiritual wisdom to my mind.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਓ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਅਨਭੈ ਠਹਰਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam peeo man tirapatiaa anabhai Thaharaio ||2||
verses.translation: Drinking deeply of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, my mind is satisfied, and my fears have been vanquished. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਨਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਦੂਖਹ ਠਾਉ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: maan aagiaa sarab sukh paae dhookheh Thaau gavaio ||
verses.translation: Accepting the Command of the Lord's Will, I have found total peace; the home of suffering has been destroyed.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jau suprasa(n)n bhe prabh Thaakur sabh aanadh roop dhikhaio ||3||
verses.translation: When God, our Lord and Master was totally pleased, He revealed everything in the form of ecstasy. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਵਤ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਵਤ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: naa kichh aavat naa kichh jaavat sabh khel keeo har raio ||
verses.translation: Nothing comes, and nothing goes; this play is all set in motion by the Lord, the Sovereign King.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੩੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak agam agam hai Thaakur bhagat Tek har naio ||4||15||136||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, our Lord and Master is inaccessible and unfathomable. The Lord's devotees take His Name as their Support. ||4||15||136||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham pooran paramesur man taa kee oT gaheejai re ||
verses.translation: He is the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Transcendent Lord; O my mind, hold tight to the Support of the One

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin dhaare brahama(n)dd kha(n)dd har taa ko naam japeejai re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: who established the solar systems and galaxies. Chant the Name of that Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man kee mat tiaagahu har jan hukam boojh sukh paieeaai re ||
verses.translation: Renounce the intellectual cleverness of your mind, O humble servants of the Lord; understanding the Hukam of His Command, peace is found.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਓਹੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo prabh karai soiee bhal maanahu sukh dhukh ohee dhiaaieeaai re ||1||
verses.translation: Whatever God does, accept that with pleasure; in comfort and in suffering, meditate on Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: koT patit udhaare khin meh karate baar na laagai re ||
verses.translation: The Creator emancipates millions of sinners in an instant, without a moment's delay.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dheen dharadh dhukh bha(n)jan suaamee jis bhaavai tiseh nivaajai re ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Destroyer of the pain and sorrow of the poor, blesses those with whom He is pleased. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko maat pitaa pratipaalak jeea praan sukh saagar re ||
verses.translation: He is Mother and Father, the Cherisher of all; He is the Breath of life of all beings, the Ocean of peace.

verses.original: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhe(n)dhe toT naahee tis karate poor rahio ratanaagar re ||3||
verses.translation: While giving so generously, the Creator does not diminish at all. The Source of jewels, He is All-pervading. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaachik jaachai naam teraa suaamee ghaT ghaT a(n)tar soiee re ||
verses.translation: The beggar begs for Your Name, O Lord and Master; God is contained deep within the nucleus of each and every heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੩੭॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas taa kee saranaiee jaa te birathaa na koiee re ||4||16||137||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak has entered His Sanctuary; no one returns from Him empty-handed. ||4||16||137||
Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har kabahoo na manahu bisaare ||
verses.translation: Never forget the Lord, Har, Har, from your mind.

verses.original: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa uoohaa sarab sukhadhaataa sagal ghaTaa pratipaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, He is the Giver of all peace. He is the Cherisher of all hearts. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਕਸਟ ਕਾਟੈ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa kasaT kaaTai khin bheetar rasanaa naam chitaare ||
verses.translation: He removes the most terrible pains in an instant, if the tongue repeats His Name.

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਜਲਤੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: seetal saa(n)t sookh har saranee jalatee agan nivaare ||1||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Sanctuary there is soothing coolness, peace and tranquility. He has extinguished the burning fire. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਡ ਨਰਕ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: garabh ku(n)dd narak te raakhai bhavajal paar utaare ||
verses.translation: He saves us from the hellish pit of the womb, and carries us across the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਰਾਧਤ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: charan kamal aaraadhat man meh jam kee traas bidhaare ||2||
verses.translation: Adoring His Lotus Feet in the mind, the fear of death is banished. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: pooran paarabraham paramesur uoochaa agam apaare ||
verses.translation: He is the Perfect, Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, lofty, unfathomable and infinite.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਜੂਏ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat dhiaavat sukh saagar jooe janam na haare ||3||
verses.translation: Singing His Glorious Praises, and meditating on the Ocean of peace, one's life is not lost in the gamble. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨੋ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh man leeno niragun ke dhaataare ||
verses.translation: My mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, O Giver to the unworthy.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੮॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apuno naam dheejai naanak sadh balihaare ||4||1||138||
verses.translation: Please grant Your Grace, and bless me with Your Name; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||138||
Raag Gauree Chaytee, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sukh naahee re har bhagat binaa ||
verses.translation: There is no peace without devotional worship of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੀਤਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਇਹੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਇਕ ਖਿਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeet janam ih ratan amolak saadhasa(n)gat jap ik khinaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Be victorious, and win the priceless jewel of this human life, by meditating on Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ॥ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਏ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਗ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sut sa(n)pat banitaa binodh || chhodd ge bahu log bhog ||1||
verses.translation: Many have renounced and left their children, wealth, spouses, joyful games and pleasures. ||1||
Horses, elephants and the pleasures of power
- leaving these behind, the fool must depart naked. ||2||
The body, scented with musk and sandalwood
- that body shall come to roll in the dust. ||3||
Infatuated with emotional attachment, they think that God is far away.
Says Nanak, he is Ever-present! ||4||1||139||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਧਰ ਤਰਬੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: man dhar tarabe har naam no ||
verses.translation: O mind, cross over with the Support of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਸੰਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saagar lahar sa(n)saa sa(n)saar gur bohith paar garaamano ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the boat to carry you across the world-ocean, through the waves of cynicism and doubt. ||1||Pause||
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there is only pitch darkness.
The lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom illuminates and enlightens. ||1||
The poison of corruption is spread out far and wide.
Only the virtuous are saved, chanting and meditating on the Lord. ||2||
Intoxicated with Maya, the people are asleep.
Meeting the Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled. ||3||
Says Nanak, meditate on the One Lord;
behold Him in each and every heart. ||4||2||140||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
You alone are my Chief Advisor.
I serve You with the Support of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
By various devices, I could not find You.
Taking hold of me, the Guru has made me Your slave. ||1||
I have conquered the five tyrants.
By Guru's Grace, I have vanquished the army of evil. ||2||
I have received the One Name as His bounty and blessing.
Now, I dwell in peace, poise and bliss. ||3||
The slaves of God are good.
O Nanak, their faces are radiant. ||4||3||141||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Hey, soul: your only Support is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਜਿ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨੋ ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਉ ਹੈ ਜਾਮ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar j karan karaavano tin meh bhau hai jaam kaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever else you do or make happen, the fear of death still hangs over you. ||1||Pause||
He is not obtained by any other efforts.
By great good fortune, meditate on the Lord. ||1||
You may know hundreds of thousands of clever tricks,
but not even one will be of any use at all hereafter. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਨੇ ॥ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਾਲੂ ਨੀਰਿ ਬਹਾਵਨੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aha(n)budh karam kamaavane || gireh baaloo neer bahaavane ||3||
verses.translation: Good deeds done in the pride of ego are swept away, like the house of sand by water. ||3||
When God the Merciful shows His Mercy,
Nanak receives the Naam in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||4||4||142||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
I am a sacrifice, dedicated hundreds of thousands of times, to my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਹੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naamo ho naam saahib ko praan adhareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: His Name, and His Name alone, is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||
You alone are the Doer, the Cause of causes.
You are the Support of all beings and creatures. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂੰ ਧਨੀ ॥ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੂੰ ਸਰਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raaj joban prabh too(n) dhanee || too(n) niragun too(n) saragunee ||2||
verses.translation: O God, You are my power, authority and youth. You are absolute, without attributes, and also related, with the most sublime attributes. ||2||
Here and hereafter, You are my Savior and Protector.
By Guru's Grace, some understand You. ||3||
God is All-knowing, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
You are Nanak's strength and support. ||4||5||143||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਉ ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g har man vasai bharam moh bhau saadheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, He dwells in the mind; doubt, emotional attachment and fear are vanquished. ||1||Pause||
The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees are heard to proclaim
that the Lord's servant dwells as the highest of all. ||1||
All places are filled with fear - know this well.
Only the Lord's servants are free of fear. ||2||
People wander through 8.4 million incarnations.
God's people are not subject to birth and death. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਹਉਮੈ ਰਹੀ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਹੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੪੪॥
verses.translit: bal budh siaanap haumai rahee || har saadh saran naanak gahee ||4||6||144||
verses.translation: Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy Saints; he has given up power, wisdom, cleverness and egotism. ||4||6||144||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: neet neet har seveeaai saas saas har dhiaaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Serve the Lord continually and continuously; with each and every breath, meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
In the Society of the Saints, the Lord dwells in the mind,
and pain, suffering, darkness and doubt depart. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦੂਖਿ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh har jaapeeaai || so jan dhookh na viaapeeaai ||2||
verses.translation: That humble being, who meditates on the Lord, by the Grace of the Saints, is not afflicted with pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau gur har ma(n)tr dhe ||
verses.translation: Those unto whom the Guru gives the Mantra of the Lord's Name,
are saved from the fire of Maya. ||3||
Be kind to Nanak, O God;

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਾਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੪੫॥
verses.translit: merai man tan vaasai naam har ||4||7||145||
verses.translation: let the Lord's Name dwell within my mind and body. ||4||7||145||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
With your tongue, chant the Name of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਘਨਾ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa sukh aana(n)dh ghanaa aagai jeea kai sa(n)g kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In this world, it shall bring you peace, comfort and great joy; hereafter, it shall go with your soul, and shall be of use to you. ||1||Pause||
The disease of your ego shall be eradicated.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too(n) gur prasaadh kar raaj jog ||1||
