Pain is forgotten, when the True Lord is found. ||1||
Beholding the blessed vision of his darshan, my understanding has become perfect.
The cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are in the dust of his feet. ||1||Pause||
My eyes are contented with the constant love of the One Lord.
My tongue is purified by the most sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||
True are my actions, and deep within my being, I serve Him.
My mind is satisfied by the Inscrutable, Mysterious Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh dhekhau teh teh saachaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I find the True Lord.
Without understanding, the world argues in falsehood. ||4||
When the Guru instructs, understanding is obtained.
How rare is that Gurmukh who understands. ||5||
Show Your Mercy, and save me, O Savior Lord!
Without understanding, people become beasts and demons. ||6||
The Guru has said that there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kis kahu dhekh karau an poojaa ||7||
verses.translation: So tell me, who should I see, and who should I worship? ||7||
For the sake of the Saints, God has established the three worlds.
One who understands his own soul, contemplates the essence of reality. ||8||
One whose heart is filled with Truth and true love

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥੯॥੮॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak ham taa ke dhaas ||9||8||
verses.translation: - prays Nanak, I am his servant. ||9||8||
Gauree, First Mehla:
Brahma acted in pride, and did not understand.
Only when he was faced with the downfall of the Vedas did he repent.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰੇ ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeh prabh simare tahee man maaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: Remembering God in meditation, the mind is conciliated. ||1||
Such is the horrible pride of the world.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis gur milai tis garab nivaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru eliminates the pride of those who meet Him. ||1||Pause||
Bal the King, in Maya and egotism,
held his ceremonial feasts, but he was puffed up with pride.
Without the Guru's advice, he had to go to the underworld. ||2||
Hari Chand gave in charity, and earned public praise.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਅਭੇਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur a(n)t na pai abhevai ||
verses.translation: But without the Guru, he did not find the limits of the Mysterious Lord.
The Lord Himself misleads people, and He Himself imparts understanding. ||3||
The evil-minded Harnaakhash committed evil deeds.
God, the Lord of all, is the Destroyer of pride.
He bestowed His Mercy, and saved Prahlaad. ||4||
Raawan was deluded, foolish and unwise.
Sri Lanka was plundered, and he lost his head.
He indulged in ego, and lacked the love of the True Guru. ||5||
The Lord killed the thousand-armed Arjun, and the demons Madhu-keetab and Meh-khaasaa.
He seized Harnaakhash and tore him apart with his nails.
The demons were slain; they did not practice devotional worship. ||6||
The demons Jaraa-sandh and Kaal-jamun were destroyed.
Rakat-beej and Kaal-naym were annihilated.
Slaying the demons, the Lord saved His Saints. ||7||
He Himself, as the True Guru, contemplates the Shabad.
Because of the love of duality, God killed the demons.
By their true devotion, the Gurmukhs have been saved. ||8||
Sinking down, Durodhan lost his honor.
He did not know the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੂਖਿ ਪਚੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: jan kau dhookh pachai dhukh hoiee ||9||
verses.translation: One who makes the Lord's humble servant suffer, shall himself suffer and rot. ||9||
Janameja did not know the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Deluded by doubt, how could he find peace?
Making a mistake, for even an instant, you shall regret and repent later on. ||10||
Kansa the King and his warriors Kays and Chandoor had no equals.

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਅਪਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam na cheeniaa apanee pat khoiee ||
verses.translation: But they did not remember the Lord, and they lost their honor.
Without the Lord of the Universe, no one can be saved. ||11||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur garab na meTiaa jai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, pride cannot be eradicated.
Following the Guru's Teachings, one obtains Dharmic faith, composure and the Lord's Name.
O Nanak, singing the Glories of God, His Name is received. ||12||9||
Gauree, First Mehla:
I may anoint my limbs with sandalwood oil.
I may dress up and wear silk and satin clothes.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin har naam kahaa sukh paavau ||1||
verses.translation: But without the Lord's Name, where would I find peace? ||1||
So what should I wear? In what clothes should I display myself?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin jagadhees kahaa sukh paavau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord of the Universe, how can I find peace? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੀ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਗਲਿ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaanee ku(n)ddal gal moteean kee maalaa ||
verses.translation: I may wear ear-rings, and a pearl necklace around my neck;
my bed may be adorned with red blankets, flowers and red powder;
but without the Lord of the Universe, where can I search for peace? ||2||
I may have a beautiful woman with fascinating eyes;
she may decorate herself with the sixteen adornments, and make herself appear gorgeous.
But without meditating on the Lord of the Universe, there is only continual suffering. ||3||
In his hearth and home, in his palace, upon his soft and comfortable bed,
day and night, the flower-girls scatter flower petals;

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸੁ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bin har naam su dheh dhukhaalee ||4||
verses.translation: but without the Lord's Name, the body is miserable. ||4||
Horses, elephants, lances, marching bands,
armies, standard bearers, royal attendants and ostentatious displays
- without the Lord of the Universe, these undertakings are all useless. ||5||
He may be called a Siddha, a man of spiritual perfection, and he may summon riches and supernatural powers;
he may place a crown upon his head, and carry a royal umbrella;
but without the Lord of the Universe, where can Truth be found? ||6||
He may be called an emperor, a lord, and a king;
he may give orders - ""Do this now, do this then"" - but this is a false display.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਸਵਰਸਿ ਕਾਜਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadh na savaras kaajaa ||7||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his works are not accomplished. ||7||
Egotism and possessiveness are dispelled by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
With the Guru's Teachings in my heart, I have come to know the Lord.
Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||8||10||
Gauree, First Mehla:
Those who serve the One Lord, do not know any other.
They abandon the bitter worldly conflicts.

verses.original: ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhai milai sach saachai sach re ||1||
verses.translation: Through love and truth, they meet the Truest of the True. ||1||
Such are the humble devotees of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gai milai mal dhoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and their pollution is washed away. ||1||Pause||
The heart-lotus of the entire universe is upside-down.
The fire of evil-mindedness is burning up the world.
They alone are saved, who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
The bumble bee, the moth, the elephant, the fish
and the deer - all suffer for their actions, and die.
Trapped by desire, they cannot see reality. ||3||
The lover of women is obsessed with sex.
All the wicked are ruined by their anger.
Honor and good sense are lost, when one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||
The self-willed manmukh is lured by another man's wife.
The noose is around his neck, and he is entangled in petty conflicts.
The Gurmukh is emancipated, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਧਵਾ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਦੇਈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau tan bidhavaa par kau dheiee ||
verses.translation: The lonely widow gives her body to a stranger;

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਦਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਪਰ ਵਸਿ ਸੇਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaam dhaam chit par vas seiee ||
verses.translation: she allows her mind to be controlled by others for lust or money

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin pir tirapat na kabahoo(n) hoiee ||6||
verses.translation: , but without her husband, she is never satisfied. ||6||

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੋਥੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਾਠਾ ॥ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੜੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਥਾਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR pothee si(n)mirat paaThaa || bedh puraan paRai sun thaaTaa ||
verses.translation: You may read, recite and study the scriptures, the Simritees, Vedas and Puraanas;

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਟਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin ras raate man bahu naaTaa ||7||
verses.translation: but without being imbued with the Lord's essence, the mind wanders endlessly. ||7||
As the rainbird thirsts longingly for the drop of rain,
and as the fish delights in the water,
Nanak is satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord. ||8||11||
Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਠੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: haTh kar marai na lekhai paavai ||
verses.translation: One who dies in stubbornness shall not be approved,
even though he may wear religious robes and smear his body all over with ashes.
Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he comes to regret and repent in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਸੂਖ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) man har jeeau too(n) man sookh ||
verses.translation: Believe in the Dear Lord, and you shall find peace of mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਸਹਹਿ ਜਮ ਦੂਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam bisaar saheh jam dhookh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, you shall have to endure the pain of death. ||1||Pause||
The smell of musk, sandalwood and camphor,
and the intoxication of Maya, takes one far away from the state of supreme dignity.
Forgetting the Naam, one becomes the most false of all the false. ||2||
Lances and swords, marching bands, thrones and the salutes of others
only increase his desire; he is engrossed in sexual desire.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਚੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin har jaache bhagat na naam ||3||
verses.translation: Without seeking the Lord, neither devotional worship nor the Naam are obtained. ||3||
Union with God is not obtained by arguments and egotism.
But by offering your mind, the comfort of the Naam is obtained.
In the love of duality and ignorance, you shall suffer. ||4||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਮ ਕੇ ਸਉਦਾ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: bin dham ke saudhaa nahee haaT ||
verses.translation: Without money, you cannot buy anything in the store.
Without a boat, you cannot cross over the ocean.
Without serving the Guru, everything is lost. ||5||

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿ ਵਾਟ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis kau vaahu vaahu j vaaT dhikhaavai ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who shows us the Way.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis kau vaahu vaahu j sabadh sunaavai ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who teaches the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tis kau vaahu vaahu j mel milaavai ||6||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who unites me in the Lord's Union. ||6||

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu tis kau jis kaa ih jeeau ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who is the Keeper of this soul.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, contemplate this Ambrosial Nectar.
The Glorious Greatness of the Naam is bestowed according to the Pleasure of Your Will. ||7||
Without the Naam, how can I live, O mother?
Night and day, I chant it; I remain in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.
O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, honor is attained. ||8||12||
Gauree, First Mehla:
Acting in egotism, the Lord is not known, even by wearing religious robes.
How rare is that Gurmukh, who surrenders his mind in devotional worship. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: hau hau karat nahee sach paieeaai ||
verses.translation: By actions done in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the True Lord is not obtained.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haumai jai param padh paieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But when egotism departs, then the state of supreme dignity is obtained. ||1||Pause||
The kings act in egotism, and undertake all sorts of expeditions.
But through their egotism, they are ruined; they die, only to be reborn over and over again. ||2||
Egotism is overcome only by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
One who restrains his fickle mind subdues the five passions. ||3||
With the True Lord deep within the self, the Celestial Mansion is intuitively found.
Understanding the Sovereign Lord, the state of supreme dignity is obtained. ||4||
The Guru dispels the doubts of those whose actions are true.
They focus their attention on the Home of the Fearless Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hau hau kar maranaa kiaa paavai ||
verses.translation: Those who act in egotism, selfishness and conceit die; what do they gain?

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੋ ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: pooraa gur bheTe so jhagar chukaavai ||6||
verses.translation: Those who meet the Perfect Guru are rid of all conflicts. ||6||
Whatever exists, is in reality nothing.
Obtaining spiritual wisdom from the Guru, I sing the Glories of God. ||7||
Egotism binds people in bondage, and causes them to wander around lost.
O Nanak, peace is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||8||13||
Gauree, First Mehla:
First, Brahma entered the house of Death.
Brahma entered the lotus, and searched the nether regions, but he did not find the end of it.
He did not accept the Lord's Order - he was deluded by doubt. ||1||
Whoever is created, shall be destroyed by Death.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham har raakhe gur sabadh beechaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But I am protected by the Lord; I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
All the gods and goddesses are enticed by Maya.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaal na chhoddai bin gur kee sevaa ||
verses.translation: Death cannot be avoided, without serving the Guru.
That Lord is Imperishable, Invisible and Inscrutable. ||2||
The sultans, emperors and kings shall not remain.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਹੁ ਭੂਲੈ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: naamahu bhoolai jam kaa dhukh sahanaa ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Name, they shall endure the pain of death.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mai dhar naam jiau raakhahu rahanaa ||3||
verses.translation: My only Support is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as He keeps me, I survive. ||3||
The leaders and kings shall not remain.
The bankers shall die, after accumulating their wealth and money.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: mai dhan dheejai har a(n)mirat naam ||4||
verses.translation: Grant me, O Lord, the wealth of Your Ambrosial Naam. ||4||
The people, rulers, leaders and chiefs
none of them shall be able to remain in the world.
Death is inevitable; it strikes the heads of the false. ||5||
Only the One Lord, the Truest of the True, is permanent.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin kar saajee tineh sabh goiee ||
verses.translation: He who created and fashioned everything, shall destroy it.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: oh gurmukh jaapai taa(n) pat hoiee ||6||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh and meditates on the Lord is honored. ||6||
The Qazis, Shaykhs and Fakeers in religious robes
call themselves great; but through their egotism, their bodies are suffering in pain.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kaal na chhoddai bin satigur kee dheeraa ||7||
verses.translation: Death does not spare them, without the Support of the True Guru. ||7||
The trap of Death is hanging over their tongues and eyes.
Death is over their ears, when they hear talk of evil.
Without the Shabad, they are plundered, day and night. ||8||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹਿ ਸਕੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai saach vasai har nai || kaal na joh sakai gun gai ||
verses.translation: Death cannot touch those whose hearts are filled with the True Name of the Lord, and who sing the Glories of God.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||9||14||
Gauree, First Mehla:
They speak the Truth - not an iota of falsehood.
The Gurmukhs walk in the Way of the Lord's Command.
They remain unattached, in the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach ghar baisai kaal na johai ||
verses.translation: They dwell in their true home, and Death does not touch them.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kau aavat jaavat dhukh mohai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs come and go, in the pain of emotional attachment. ||1||Pause||
So, drink deeply of this Nectar, and speak the Unspoken Speech.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar bais sahaj ghar laheeaai ||
verses.translation: Dwelling in the home of your own being within, you shall find the home of intuitive peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har ras maate ih sukh kaheeaai ||2||
verses.translation: One who is imbued with the Lord's sublime essence, is said to experience this peace. ||2||
Following the Guru's Teachings, one becomes perfectly stable, and never wavers.
Following the Guru's Teachings, one intuitively chants the Name of the True Lord.
Drinking in this Ambrosial Nectar, and churning it, the essential reality is discerned. ||3||
Beholding the True Guru, I have received His Teachings.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਓ ਅੰਤਰ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: man tan arapio a(n)tar gat keenee ||
verses.translation: I have offered my mind and body, after searching deep within my own being.
I have come to realize the value of understanding my own soul. ||4||
The Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord, is the most excellent and sublime food.
The pure swan-souls see the True Light of the Infinite Lord.
Wherever I look, I see the One and Only Lord. ||5||
One who remains pure and unblemished and practices only true deeds,

verses.original: ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: param padh paiaa sevaa gur charanee ||
verses.translation: obtains the supreme status, serving at the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਚੂਕੀ ਅਹੰ ਭ੍ਰਮਣੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: man te man maaniaa chookee aha(n) bhramanee ||6||
verses.translation: The mind is reconciliated with the mind, and the ego's wandering ways come to an end. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ein bidh kaun kaun nahee taariaa ||
verses.translation: In this way, who - who has not been saved?
The Lord's Praises have saved His Saints and devotees.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਏ ਹਮ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: prabh paae ham avar na bhaariaa ||7||
verses.translation: I have found God - I am not searching for any other. ||7||
The Guru has shown me the unseen Mansion of the True Lord.
His Mansion is eternal and unchanging; it is not a mere reflection of Maya.
Through truth and contentment, doubt is dispelled. ||8||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai man vasiaa sach soiee ||
verses.translation: That person, within whose mind the True Lord dwells
in his company, one becomes Gurmukh.
O Nanak, the True Name washes off the pollution. ||9||15||
Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਾਪੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam chit raapai jaa kaa ||
verses.translation: One whose consciousness is permeated with the Lord's Name
- receive the blessing of his darshan in the early light of dawn. ||1||
If you do not meditate on the Lord, it is your own misfortune.

verses.original: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug dhaataa prabh raam hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In each and every age, the Great Giver is my Lord God. ||1||Pause||
Following the Guru's Teachings, the perfect humble beings meditate on the Lord.
Within their hearts, the unstruck melody vibrates. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan raam bhagat har piaar ||
verses.translation: Those who worship the Lord and love the Lord
- showering His Mercy, God protects them. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai hiradhai har har soiee ||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, Har, Har

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tin kaa dharas paras sukh hoiee ||4||
verses.translation: - gazing upon the blessed vision of their darshan, peace is obtained. ||4||
Among all beings, the One Lord is pervading.
The eogtistical, self-willed manmukhs wander in reincarnation. ||5||
They alone understand, who have found the True Guru.
Subduing their ego, they receive the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||6||

verses.original: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਧਿ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: aradh uradh kee sa(n)dh kiau jaanai ||
verses.translation: How can anyone know of the Union between the being below and the Supreme Being above?
The Gurmukhs obtain this Union; their minds are reconciliated. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: ham paapee niragun kau gun kareeaai ||
verses.translation: I am a worthless sinner, without merit. What merit do I have?

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: prabh hoi dhiaal naanak jan tareeaai ||8||16||
verses.translation: When God showers His Mercy, servant Nanak is emancipated. ||8||16||
Sixteen Ashtpadheeyaa Of Gwaarayree Gauree||
Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਗਾਈ ਕਉ ਗੋਇਲੀ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪਾਲਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau gaiee kau goilee raakheh kar saaraa || ahinis paaleh raakh leh aatam sukh dhaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: As the dairy farmer watches over and protects his cows, so does the Lord cherish and protect us, night and day. He blesses the soul with peace. ||1||
Please protect me here and hereafter, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.
I seek Your Sanctuary; please bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਰਖੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhau teh rav rahe rakh raakhanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there You are. Save me, O Savior Lord!

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhaataa bhugataa too(n)hai too(n) praan adhaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: You are the Giver, and You are the Enjoyer; You are the Support of the breath of life. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਅਧ ਊਰਧੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kirat piaa adh uooradhee bin giaan beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: According to the karma of past actions, people descend to the depths or rise to the heights, unless they contemplate spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin upamaa jagadhees kee binasai na a(n)dhiaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the darkness is not dispelled. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਲੋਭੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jag binasat ham dhekhiaa lobhe aha(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: I have seen the world being destroyed by greed and egotism.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa prabh paiaa sach mukat dhuaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: Only by serving the Guru is God obtained, and the true gate of liberation found. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੋ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar mahal apaar ko apara(n)par soiee ||
verses.translation: The Mansion of the Infinite Lord's Presence is within the home of one's own being. He is beyond any boundaries.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai thir ko nahee boojhai sukh hoiee ||5||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, nothing shall endure. Through understanding, peace is obtained. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਆ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa lai aaiaa le jai kiaa faaseh jam jaalaa ||
verses.translation: What have you brought, and what will you take away, when you are caught by the noose of Death?

verses.original: ਡੋਲੁ ਬਧਾ ਕਸਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਪਤਾਲਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ddol badhaa kas jevaree aakaas pataalaa ||6||
verses.translation: Like the bucket tied to the rope in the well, you are pulled up to the Akaashic Ethers, and then lowered down to the nether regions of the underworld. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat naam na veesarai sahaje pat paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall automatically obtain honor.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar sabadh nidhaan hai mil aap gavaieeaai ||7||
verses.translation: Deep within the self is the treasure of the Shabad; it is obtained only by eradicating selfishness and conceit. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare prabh aapanee gun a(n)k samaavai ||
verses.translation: When God bestows His Glance of Grace, people settle in the Lap of the Virtuous Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naanak mel na chookiee laahaa sach paavai ||8||1||17||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this Union cannot be broken; the true profit is obtained. ||8||1||17||
Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝਿ ਲੇ ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee boojh le tau hoi niberaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand, and then, the account is settled.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar naam nira(n)janaa so Thaakur meraa ||1||
verses.translation: In each and every heart is the Name of the Immaculate Lord; He is my Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadh na chhooTeeaai dhekhahu veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, no one is emancipated. See this, and reflect upon it.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: je lakh karam kamaavahee bin gur a(n)dhiaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Even though you may perform hundreds of thousands of rituals, without the Guru, there is only darkness. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਅਕਲੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe akalee baahare kiaa tin siau kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: What can you say, to one who is blind and without wisdom?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਰਬਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin gur pa(n)th na soojhiee kit bidh nirabaheeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the Path cannot be seen. How can anyone proceed? ||2||

verses.original: ਖੋਟੇ ਕਉ ਖਰਾ ਕਹੈ ਖਰੇ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: khoTe kau kharaa kahai khare saar na jaanai ||
verses.translation: He calls the counterfeit genuine, and does not know the value of the genuine.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe kaa naau paarakhoo kalee kaal viddaanai ||3||
verses.translation: The blind man is known as an appraiser; this Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so strange! ||3||

verses.original: ਸੂਤੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਗਤ ਕਉ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: soote kau jaagat kahai jaagat kau sootaa ||
verses.translation: The sleeper is said to be awake, and those who are awake are like sleepers.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਕਉ ਮੂਆ ਕਹੈ ਮੂਏ ਨਹੀ ਰੋਤਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jeevat kau mooaa kahai mooe nahee rotaa ||4||
verses.translation: The living are said to be dead, and no one mourns for those who have died. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਕਉ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਤੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavat kau jaataa kahai jaate kau aaiaa ||
verses.translation: One who is coming is said to be going, and one who is gone is said to have come.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਕੀ ਕਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਹੈ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: par kee kau apunee kahai apuno nahee bhaiaa ||5||
verses.translation: That which belongs to others, he calls his own, but he has no liking for that which is his. ||5||

verses.original: ਮੀਠੇ ਕਉ ਕਉੜਾ ਕਹੈ ਕੜੂਏ ਕਉ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: meeThe kau kauRaa kahai kaRooe kau meeThaa ||
verses.translation: That which is sweet is said to be bitter, and the bitter is said to be sweet.

verses.original: ਰਾਤੇ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਐਸਾ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: raate kee ni(n)dhaa kareh aaisaa kal meh ddeeThaa ||6||
verses.translation: One who is imbued with the Lord's Love is slandered - this is what I have seen in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||6||

verses.original: ਚੇਰੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: cheree kee sevaa kareh Thaakur nahee dheesai ||
verses.translation: He serves the maid, and does not see his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਪੋਖਰੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੀਐ ਮਾਖਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਰੀਸੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: pokhar neer viroleeaai maakhan nahee reesai ||7||
verses.translation: Churning the water in the pond, no butter is produced. ||7||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਪਦ ਜੋ ਅਰਥਾਇ ਲੇਇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis padh jo arathai lei so guroo hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: One who understands the meaning of this verse is my Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਸੋ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak cheenai aap kau so apar apaaraa ||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who knows his own self, is infinite and incomparable. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh aape aap varatadhaa aape bharamaiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself misleads the people.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੯॥੨॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te boojheeaai sabh braham samaiaa ||9||2||18||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand, that God is contained in all. ||9||2||18||

verses.translit: raag gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The pollution of the mind is the love of duality.
Deluded by doubt, people come and go in reincarnation. ||1||
The pollution of the self-willed manmukhs will never go away,

verses.original: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jichar sabadh na bheejai har kai nai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: as long as they do not dwell on the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
All the created beings are contaminated by emotional attachment;
they die and are reborn, only to die over and over again. ||2||
Fire, air and water are polluted.
The food which is eaten is polluted. ||3||
The actions of those who do not worship the Lord are polluted.
Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes immaculate. ||4||
Serving the True Guru, pollution is eradicated,

verses.original: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: marai na janamai kaal na khai ||5||
verses.translation: and then, one does not suffer death and rebirth, or get devoured by death. ||5||
You may study and examine the Shaastras and the Simritees,

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: vin naavai ko mukat na hoi ||6||
verses.translation: but without the Name, no one is liberated. ||6||

verses.original: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jug chaare naam utam sabadh beechaar ||
verses.translation: Throughout the four ages, the Naam is the ultimate; reflect upon the Word of the Shabad.
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only the Gurmukhs cross over. ||7||
The True Lord does not die; He does not come or go.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains absorbed in the Lord. ||8||1||
Gauree, Third Mehla:
Selfless service is the support of the breath of life of the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau raakhahu hiradhai ur dhaaraa ||
verses.translation: Keep the Dear Lord enshrined in your heart.
The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||
O Pandit, O religious scholar, read about the Lord, and renounce your corrupt ways.
The Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
The Gurmukh eradicates egotism from within.
No filth sticks to the Gurmukh.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind of the Gurmukh. ||2||
Through karma and Dharma, good actions and righteous faith, the Gurmukh becomes true.
The Gurmukh burns away egotism and duality.
The Gurmukh is attuned to the Naam, and is at peace. ||3||
Instruct your own mind, and understand Him.
You may preach to other people, but no one will listen.
The Gurmukh understands, and is always at peace. ||4||
The self-willed manmukhs are such clever hypocrites.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kamaavai su thai na paiee ||
verses.translation: No matter what they do, it is not acceptable.
They come and go in reincarnation, and find no place of rest. ||5||
The manmukhs perform their rituals, but they are totally selfish and conceited.

verses.original: ਬਗ ਜਿਉ ਲਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bag jiau lai bahai nit dhiaanaa ||
verses.translation: They sit there, like storks, pretending to meditate.
Caught by the Messenger of Death, they shall regret and repent in the end. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve mukat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.
By Guru's Grace, one meets the Lord.
The Guru is the Great Giver, throughout the four ages. ||7||
For the Gurmukh, the Naam is social status, honor and glorious greatness.
Maya, the daughter of the ocean, has been slain.
O Nanak, without the Name, all clever tricks are false. ||8||2||
Gauree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis jug kaa dharam paRahu tum bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Learn the Dharma of this age, O Siblings of Destiny;
all understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru.
Here and hereafter, the Lord's Name is our Companion. ||1||
Learn of the Lord, and contemplate Him in your mind.
By Guru's Grace, your filth shall be washed away. ||1||Pause||
Through argument and debate, He cannot be found.
The mind and body are made insipid through the love of duality.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh sach liv lai ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, lovingly attune yourself to the True Lord. ||2||
This world is polluted with egotism.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: nit teerath naavai na jai aha(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: By taking cleansing baths daily at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, egotism is not eliminated.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin gur bheTe jam kare khuaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: Without meeting the Guru, they are tortured by Death. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so jan saachaa j haumai maarai ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings are true, who conquer their ego.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they conquer the five thieves.
They save themselves, and save all their generations as well. ||4||
The Actor has staged the drama of emotional attachment to Maya.
The self-willed manmukhs cling blindly to it.
The Gurmukhs remain detached, and lovingly attune themselves to the Lord. ||5||
The disguisers put on their various disguises.
Desire rages within them, and they carry on egotistically.
They do not understand themselves, and they lose the game of life. ||6||
Putting on religious robes, they act so clever,
but they are totally deluded by doubt and emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin gur seve bahut dhukh paiee ||7||
verses.translation: Without serving the Guru, they suffer in terrible pain. ||7||
Those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, remain detached forever.
Even as householders, they lovingly attune themselves to the True Lord.
O Nanak, those who serve the True Guru are blessed and very fortunate. ||8||3||
Gauree, Third Mehla:
Brahma is the founder of the study of the Vedas.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਦੇਵ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: tis te upaje dhev moh piaasaa ||
verses.translation: From him emanated the gods, enticed by desire.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: trai gun bharame naahee nij ghar vaasaa ||1||
verses.translation: They wander in the three qualities, and they do not dwell within their own home. ||1||
The Lord has saved me; I have met the True Guru.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat har naam dhiraRaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has implanted devotional worship of the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||
The songs of Brahma entangle people in the three qualities.

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮਕਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: paR vaadh vakhaaneh sir maare jamakaalaa ||
verses.translation: Reading about the debates and disputes, they are hit over the head by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tat na cheeneh ba(n)neh pa(n)dd paraalaa ||2||
verses.translation: They do not understand the essence of reality, and they gather their worthless bundles of straw. ||2||
The self-willed manmukhs, in ignorance, take the path of evil.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har naam bisaariaa bahu karam dhiraRaae ||
verses.translation: They forget the Lord's Name, and in its place, they establish all sorts of rituals.
They drown in the terrifying world-ocean, in the love of duality. ||3||
Driven crazy, infatuated by Maya, they call themselves Pandits - religious scholars;
stained with corruption, they suffer terrible pain.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jam kaa gal jevaRaa nit kaal sa(n)taavai ||4||
verses.translation: The noose of the Messenger of Death is around their necks; they are constantly tormented by death. ||4||
The Messenger of Death does not even approach the Gurmukhs.
Through the Word of the Shabad, they burn away their ego and duality.
Attuned to the Name, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾਸੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa dhaasee bhagataa kee kaar kamaavai ||
verses.translation: Maya is the slave of the Lord's devotees; it works for them.
One who falls at their feet attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
He is forever immaculate; he is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: har kathaa suneh se dhanava(n)t dhiseh jug maahee ||
verses.translation: Those who listen to the Lord's Sermon are seen to be the wealthy people in this world.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: tin kau sabh niveh anadhin pooj karaahee ||
verses.translation: Everyone bows down to them, and adores them, night and day.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sahaje gun raveh saache man maahee ||7||
verses.translation: They intuitively savor the Glories of the True Lord within their minds. ||7||
The Perfect True Guru has revealed the Shabad;

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਚਉਥੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun meTe chauthai chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: it eradicates the three qualities, and attunes the consciousness to the fourth state.
O Nanak, subduing egotism, one is absorbed into God. ||8||4||
Gauree, Third Mehla:
Brahma studied the Vedas, but these lead only to debates and disputes.
He is filled with darkness; he does not understand himself.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa prabh paae gur sabadh vakhaanai ||1||
verses.translation: And yet, if he chants the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he finds God. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa karau fir kaal na khai ||
verses.translation: So serve the Guru, and you shall not be consumed by death.
The self-willed manmukhs have been consumed by the love of duality. ||1||Pause||
Becoming Gurmukh, the sinful mortals are purified.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰੀਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh a(n)tar sahaj reedhe ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they find intuitive peace and poise deep within.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh paiaa gur kai sabadh seedhe ||2||
verses.translation: I have found my God, through the Guru's Shabad, and I have been reformed. ||2||
God Himself unites us in Union with the True Guru,

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: mere prabh saache kai man bhaae ||
verses.translation: when we become pleasing to the Mind of my True God.
They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in the poise of celestial peace. ||3||
Without the True Guru, they are deluded by doubt.
The blind, self-willed manmukhs constantly eat poison.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jam dda(n)dd saheh sadhaa dhukh paae ||4||
verses.translation: They are beaten by the Messenger of Death with his rod, and they suffer in constant pain. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਮੂਆ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jamooaa na johai har kee saranaiee ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not catch sight of those who enter the Sanctuary of the Lord.
Subduing egotism, they lovingly center their consciousness on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sadhaa rahai har naam liv laiee ||5||
verses.translation: They keep their consciousness constantly focused on the Lord's Name. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seveh se jan niramal pavitaa ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are pure and immaculate.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: man siau man milai sabh jag jeetaa ||
verses.translation: Merging their minds into the Mind, they conquer the entire world.

verses.original: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ein bidh kusal terai mere meetaa ||6||
verses.translation: In this way, you too shall find happiness, O my friend. ||6||
Those who serve the True Guru are blessed with fruitful rewards.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides in their hearts; selfishness and conceit depart from within them.
The unstruck melody of the Shabad vibrates for them. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਨ ਸੀਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te kavan kavan na seedho mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Who - who has not been purified by the True Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny?
The devotees are purified, and honored in His Court.
O Nanak, greatness is in the Lord's Name. ||8||5||
Gauree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun vakhaanai bharam na jai ||
verses.translation: Those who speak of the three qualities - their doubts do not depart.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan na tooTeh mukat na pai ||
verses.translation: Their bonds are not broken, and they do not obtain liberation.
The True Guru is the Bestower of liberation in this age. ||1||
Those mortals who become Gurmukh give up their doubts.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj dhun upajai har liv lai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The celestial music wells up, when they lovingly attune their consciousness to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun kaalai kee sir kaaraa ||
verses.translation: Those who are controlled by the three qualities have death hovering over their heads.
They do not remember the Name of the Creator Lord.
They die, and are reborn, over and over, again and again. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe guroo te bharam na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Those whose guru is spiritually blind - their doubts are not dispelled.
Abandoning the Source of all, they have become attached to the love of duality.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bikh kaa maataa bikh maeh samaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Infected with poison, they are immersed in poison. ||3||
Believing Maya to be the source of all, they wander in doubt.
They have forgotten the Dear Lord, and they are in love with duality.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jis nadhar kare so param gat paae ||4||
verses.translation: The supreme status is obtained only by those who are blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||4||
One who has Truth pervading within, radiates Truth outwardly as well.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਛਪੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਰਖੈ ਛਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saach na chhapai je ko rakhai chhapaae ||
verses.translation: The Truth does not remain hidden, even though one may try to hide it.
The spiritually wise know this intuitively. ||5||
The Gurmukhs keep their consciousness lovingly centered on the Lord.
Ego and Maya are burned away by the Word of the Shabad.
My True God unites them in His Union. ||6||
The True Guru, The Giver, preaches the Shabad.
He controls, and restrains, and holds still the wandering mind.
Understanding is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa sirasaT siraj jin goiee ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself has created the universe; He Himself shall destroy it.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin dhoojaa avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: Without Him, there is no other at all.
O Nanak, how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this! ||8||6||
Gauree, Third Mehla:
The Gurmukhs obtain the Naam, the Priceless Name of the Lord.
They serve the Name, and through the Name, they are absorbed in intuitive peace and poise.
With their tongues, they continually sing the Ambrosial Naam.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kare so har ras paavai ||1||
verses.translation: They obtain the Lord's Name; the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||
Night and day, within your heart, meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਸੂਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh paavau param padh sookhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs obtain the supreme state of peace. ||1||Pause||
Peace comes to fill the hearts of those
who, as Gurmukh, sing of the True Lord, the treasure of excellence.
They become the constant slaves of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.
Within their households and families, they remain always detached. ||2||
How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, become Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.
They alone obtain the supreme treasure.
Eradicating the three qualities, they become pure.
They are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: moh kuTa(n)b siau preet na hoi ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment to family does not exist,
when the True Lord abides within the heart.
The mind of the Gurmukh is pierced through and held steady.
One who recognizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command understands the True Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) karataa mai avar na koi ||
verses.translation: You are the Creator Lord - there is no other for me.

verses.original: ਤੁਝੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tujh sevee tujh te pat hoi ||
verses.translation: I serve You, and through You, I obtain honor.
God showers His Mercy, and I sing His Praises.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naam ratan sabh jag meh loi ||5||
verses.translation: The light of the jewel of the Naam permeates the entire world. ||5||
To the Gurmukhs, the Word of God's Bani seems so sweet.
Deep within, their hearts blossom forth; night and day, they lovingly center themselves on the Lord.
The True Lord is intuitively obtained, by His Grace.
The True Guru is obtained by the destiny of perfect good fortune. ||6||
Egotism, possessiveness, evil-mindedness and suffering depart,
when the Lord's Name, the Ocean of Virtue, comes to dwell within the heart.
The intellect of the Gurmukhs is awakened, and they praise God,
when the Lord's Lotus Feet come to dwell within the heart. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam dhei soiee jan paae ||
verses.translation: They alone receive the Naam, unto whom it is given.
The Gurmukhs shed their ego, and merge with the Lord.
The True Name abides within their hearts.
O Nanak, they are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||8||7||
Gauree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਭੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man hee man savaariaa bhai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: The mind has intuitively healed itself, through the Fear of God.
The mind is attuned to the Word of the Shabad; it is lovingly attuned to the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nij ghar vasiaa prabh kee rajai ||1||
verses.translation: It abides within its own home, in harmony with the Lord's Will. ||1||
Serving the True Guru, egotistical pride departs,
and the Lord of the Universe, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man bairaagee jaa sabadh bhau khai ||
verses.translation: The mind becomes detached and free of desire, when it experiences the Fear of God, through the Shabad.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh niramalaa sabh tai rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: My Immaculate God is pervading and contained among all.
By Guru's Grace, one is united in His Union. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har dhaasan ko dhaas sukh paae ||
verses.translation: The slave of the Lord's slave attains peace.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: meraa har prabh in bidh paiaa jaae ||
verses.translation: My Lord God is found in this way.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa te raam gun gaae ||3||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Lord, one comes to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਹੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag bahu jeevan jit har naam na lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: Cursed is that long life, during which love for the Lord's Name is not enshrined.

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag sej sukhaalee kaaman moh gubaar ||
verses.translation: Cursed is that comfortable bed which lures one into the darkness of attachment to sexual desire.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tin safal janam jin naam adhaar ||4||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the birth of that person who takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag dhirag girahu kuTa(n)b jit har preet na hoi ||
verses.translation: Cursed, cursed is that home and family, in which the love of the Lord is not embraced.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: soiee hamaaraa meet jo har gun gaavai soi ||
verses.translation: He alone is my friend, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: har naam binaa mai avar na koi ||5||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, there is no other for me. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te ham gat pat paiee ||
verses.translation: From the True Guru, I have obtained salvation and honor.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har naam dhiaaiaa dhookh sagal miTaiee ||
verses.translation: I have meditated on the Name of the Lord, and all my sufferings have been erased.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh har naam liv laiee ||6||
verses.translation: I am in constant bliss, lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਰੀਰ ਸੁਧਿ ਭਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai ham kau sareer sudh bhiee ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, I came to understand my body.
The fires of ego and desire have been totally quenched.
Anger has been dispelled, and I have grasped hold of tolerance. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har aape kirapaa kare naam dhevai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself showers His Mercy, and bestows the Naam.
How rare is that Gurmukh, who receives the jewel of the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੈ ॥੮॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak gun gaavai har alakh abhevai ||8||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Unknowable, the Incomprehensible. ||8||8||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰੇ ਤੇ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਬੁਰੇ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te jo muh fere te vemukh bure dhisa(n)n ||
verses.translation: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, are seen to be unfaithful and evil.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਨਾ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin badhe maareean fir velaa naa laha(n)n ||1||
verses.translation: They shall be bound and beaten night and day; they shall not have this opportunity again. ||1||
O Lord, please shower Your Mercy upon me, and save me!

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat melai prabh har hiradhai har gun saar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord God, please lead me to meet the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, that I may dwell upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord within my heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: se bhagat har bhaavadhe jo gurmukh bhai chala(n)n ||
verses.translation: Those devotees are pleasing to the Lord, who as Gurmukh, walk in harmony with the Way of the Lord's Will.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਨਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਏ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap chhodd sevaa karan jeevat mue raha(n)n ||2||
verses.translation: Subduing their selfishness and conceit, and performing selfless service, they remain dead while yet alive. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhaa pi(n)dd paraan hai tis kee sir kaar ||
verses.translation: The body and the breath of life belong to the One - perform the greatest service to Him.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oh kiau manahu visaareeaai har rakheeaai hiradhai dhaar ||3||
verses.translation: Why forget Him from your mind? Keep the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam miliaai pat paieeaai naam ma(n)niaai sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Receiving the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains honor; believing in the Naam, one is at peace.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: satigur te naam paieeaai karam milai prabh soi ||4||
verses.translation: The Naam is obtained from the True Guru; by His Grace, God is found. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ ਓਇ ਭ੍ਰਮਦੇ ਨਾ ਟਿਕੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te jo muh fere oi bhramadhe naa Tika(n)n ||
verses.translation: They turn their faces away from the True Guru; they continue to wander aimlessly.

verses.original: ਧਰਤਿ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਝਲਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਪਏ ਪਚੰਨਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dharat asamaan na jhaliee vich visaTaa pe pacha(n)n ||5||
verses.translation: They are not accepted by the earth or the sky; they fall into manure, and rot. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih jag bharam bhulaiaa moh Thagaulee pai ||
verses.translation: This world is deluded by doubt - it has taken the drug of emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੈ ਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jinaa satigur bheTiaa tin neR na bhiTai mai ||6||
verses.translation: Maya does not draw near those who have met with the True Guru. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੋ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sevan so sohane haumai mail gavai ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru are very beautiful; they cast off the filth of selfishness and conceit.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate se niramale chaleh satigur bhai ||7||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are immaculate and pure. They walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh dhaataa ek too(n) too(n) aape bakhas milai ||
verses.translation: O Lord God, You are the One and Only Giver; You forgive us, and unite us with Yourself.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
verses.translit: jan naanak saranaagatee jiau bhaavai tivai chhaddai ||8||1||9||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; if it is Your Will, please save him! ||8||1||9||

verses.translit: raag gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa karahale
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla, Karhalay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਰਹਲੇ ਮਨ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: karahale man paradheseeaa kiau mileeaai har mai ||
verses.translation: O my wandering mind, you are like a camel - how will you meet the Lord, your Mother?

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur bhaag poorai paiaa gal miliaa piaaraa aai ||1||
verses.translation: When I found the Guru, by the destiny of perfect good fortune, my Beloved came and embraced me. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa satigur purakh dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O camel-like mind, meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa veechaareeaa har raam naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O camel-like mind, contemplate the Lord, and meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeaai har aape le chhaddai ||2||
verses.translation: When you are called to answer for your account, the Lord Himself shall release you. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa at niramalaa mal laagee haumai aai ||
verses.translation: O camel-like mind, you were once very pure; the filth of egotism has now attached itself to you.

verses.original: ਪਰਤਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paratakh pir ghar naal piaaraa vichhuR choTaa khai ||3||
verses.translation: Your Beloved Husband is now manifest before you in your own home, but you are separated from Him, and you suffer such pain! ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਲਿ ਭਾਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa mere preetamaa har ridhai bhaal bhaalai ||
verses.translation: O my beloved camel-like mind, search for the Lord within your own heart.

verses.original: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aupai kitai na labhiee gur hiradhai har dhekhai ||4||
verses.translation: He cannot be found by any device; the Guru will show you the Lord within your heart. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa mere preetamaa dhin rain har liv lai ||
verses.translation: O my beloved camel-like mind, day and night, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord.

verses.original: ਘਰੁ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ghar jai paaveh ra(n)g mahalee gur mele har melai ||5||
verses.translation: Return to your own home, and find the palace of love; meet the Guru, and meet the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa too(n) meet meraa paakha(n)dd lobh tajai ||
verses.translation: O camel-like mind, you are my friend; abandon hypocrisy and greed.

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd lobhee maareeaai jam dda(n)dd dhei sajai ||6||
verses.translation: The hypocritical and the greedy are struck down; the Messenger of Death punishes them with his club. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤੂੰ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa mere praan too(n) mail paakha(n)dd bharam gavai ||
verses.translation: O camel-like mind, you are my breath of life; rid yourself of the pollution of hypocrisy and doubt.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har a(n)mirat sar gur pooriaa mil sa(n)gatee mal leh jai ||7||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru is the Ambrosial Pool of the Lord's Nectar; join the Holy Congregation, and wash away this pollution. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa mere piaariaa ik gur kee sikh sunai ||
verses.translation: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, listen only to the Teachings of the Guru.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: eih moh maiaa pasariaa a(n)t saath na koiee jai ||8||
verses.translation: This emotional attachment to Maya is so pervasive. Ultimately, nothing shall go along with anyone. ||8||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa mere saajanaa har kharach leeaa pat pai ||
verses.translation: O camel-like mind, my good friend, take the supplies of the Lord's Name, and obtain honor.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: har dharageh painaiaa har aap liaa gal lai ||9||
verses.translation: In the Court of the Lord, you shall be robed with honor, and the Lord Himself shall embrace you. ||9||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa gur ma(n)niaa gurmukh kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: O camel-like mind, one who surrenders to the Guru becomes Gurmukh, and works for the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur aagai kar jodhaRee jan naanak har melai ||10||1||
verses.translation: Offer your prayers to the Guru; O servant Nanak, He shall unite you with the Lord. ||10||1||
Gauree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa veechaareeaa veechaar dhekh samaal ||
verses.translation: O contemplative camel-like mind, contemplate and look carefully.

verses.original: ਬਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ban fir thake ban vaaseeaa pir gurmat ridhai nihaal ||1||
verses.translation: The forest-dwellers have grown weary of wandering in the forests; following the Guru's Teachings, see your Husband Lord within your heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa gur govi(n)dh samaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O camel-like mind, dwell upon the Guru and the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਾਥਿਆ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa veechaareeaa manmukh faathiaa mahaa jaal ||
verses.translation: O camel-like contemplative mind, the self-willed manmukhs are caught in the great net.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh praanee mukat hai har har naam samaal ||2||
verses.translation: The mortal who becomes Gurmukh is liberated, dwelling upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa mere piaariaa satasa(n)gat satigur bhaal ||
verses.translation: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, seek the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat lag har dhiaaieeaai har har chalai terai naal ||3||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, meditate on the Lord, and the Lord, Har, Har, shall go along with you. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa vaddabhaageeaa har ek nadhar nihaal ||
verses.translation: O very fortunate camel-like mind, with one Glance of Grace from the Lord, you shall be enraptured.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aap chhaddaae chhuTeeaai satigur charan samaal ||4||
verses.translation: If the Lord Himself saves you, then you shall be saved. Dwell upon the Feet of the True Guru. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa mere piaariaa vich dhehee jot samaal ||
verses.translation: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, dwell upon the Divine Light within the body.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਦਇਆਲਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur nau nidh naam vikhaaliaa har dhaat karee dhiaal ||5||
verses.translation: The Guru has shown me the nine treasures of the Naam. The Merciful Lord has bestowed this gift. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਚੰਚਲਾ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਛਡਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa too(n) cha(n)chalaa chaturaiee chhadd vikaraal ||
verses.translation: O camel-like mind, you are so fickle; give up your cleverness and corruption.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har har naam samaal too(n) har mukat kare a(n)t kaal ||6||
verses.translation: Dwell upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; at the very last moment, the Lord shall liberate you. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man karahalaa vaddabhaageeaa too(n) giaan ratan samaal ||
verses.translation: O camel-like mind, you are so very fortunate; dwell upon the jewel of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਖੜਗੁ ਹਥਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿਅੜਾ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur giaan khaRag hath dhaariaa jam maariaRaa jamakaal ||7||
verses.translation: You hold in your hands the sword of the Guru's spiritual wisdom; with this destroyer of death, kill the Messenger of Death. ||7||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar nidhaan man karahale bhram bhaveh baahar bhaal ||
verses.translation: The treasure is deep within, O camel-like mind, but you wander around outside in doubt, searching for it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧੜਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gur purakh pooraa bheTiaa har sajan ladhaRaa naal ||8||
verses.translation: Meeting the Perfect Guru, the Primal Being, you shall discover that the Lord, your Best Friend, is with you. ||8||

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜੇ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g rataRe man karahale har ra(n)g sadhaa samaal ||
verses.translation: You are engrossed in pleasures, O camel-like mind; dwell upon the Lord's lasting love instead!

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g kadhe na utarai gur sevaa sabadh samaal ||9||
verses.translation: The color of the Lord's Love never fades away; serve the Guru, and dwell upon the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਕਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: ham pa(n)khee man karahale har taravar purakh akaal ||
verses.translation: We are birds, O camel-like mind; the Lord, the Immortal Primal Being, is the tree.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee gurmukh paiaa jan naanak naam samaal ||10||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are very fortunate - they find it. O servant Nanak, dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||2||

verses.translit: raag gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satinaam karataa purakh gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab ih man meh karat gumaanaa ||
verses.translation: When this mind is filled with pride,
then it wanders around like a madman and a lunatic.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਹੂਆ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab ih hooaa sagal kee reenaa ||
verses.translation: But when it becomes the dust of all,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਮਈਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa te ramieeaa ghaT ghaT cheenaa ||1||
verses.translation: then it recognizes the Lord in each and every heart. ||1||
The fruit of humility is intuitive peace and pleasure.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur apunai moh dhaan dheenee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My True Guru has given me this gift. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab kis kau ih jaanas ma(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: When he believes others to be bad,
then everyone lays traps for him.
But when he stops thinking in terms of 'mine' and 'yours',

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa te is sa(n)g nahee bairaiee ||2||
verses.translation: then no one is angry with him. ||2||
When he clings to 'my own, my own',

verses.original: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tab is kau hai musakal bhaaree ||
verses.translation: then he is in deep trouble.
But when he recognizes the Creator Lord,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tab is no naahee kichh taataa ||3||
verses.translation: then he is free of torment. ||3||
When he entangles himself in emotional attachment,
he comes and goes in reincarnation, under the constant gaze of Death.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab is te sabh binase bharamaa ||
verses.translation: But when all his doubts are removed,
then there is no difference between him and the Supreme Lord God. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਭੇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab in kichh kar maane bhedhaa ||
verses.translation: When he perceives differences,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਡੰਡ ਅਰੁ ਖੇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: tab te dhookh dda(n)dd ar khedhaa ||
verses.translation: then he suffers pain, punishment and sorrow.
But when he recognizes the One and Only Lord,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tab te is no sabh kichh soojhiaa ||5||
verses.translation: he understands everything. ||5||
When he runs around for the sake of Maya and riches,
he is not satisfied, and his desires are not quenched.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਜਉਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab is te ih hoio jaulaa ||
verses.translation: But when he runs away from Maya,
then the Goddess of Wealth gets up and follows him. ||6||
When, by His Grace, the True Guru is met,
the lamp is lit within the temple of the mind.
When he realizes what victory and defeat really are,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tau is ghar kee keemat paree ||7||
verses.translation: then he comes to appreciate the true value of his own home. ||7||
The One Lord is the Creator of all things, the Cause of causes.
He Himself is wisdom, contemplation and discerning understanding.

verses.original: ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhoor na nerai sabh kai sa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: He is not far away; He is near at hand, with all.
So praise the True One, O Nanak, with love! ||8||1||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Serving the Guru, one is committed to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: tis kau miliaa jis masatak bhaagaa ||
verses.translation: It is received only by those who have such good destiny inscribed upon their foreheads.
The Lord dwells within their hearts.
Their minds and bodies become peaceful and stable. ||1||
O my mind, sing such Praises of the Lord,

verses.original: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਜੋ ਕਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa uoohaa jo kaam terai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: which shall be of use to you here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||
Meditating on Him, fear and misfortune depart,
and the wandering mind is held steady.

verses.original: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaas japat fir dhookh na laagai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, suffering shall never again overtake you.
Meditating on Him, this ego runs away. ||2||
Meditating on Him, the five passions are overcome.
Meditating on Him, Ambrosial Nectar is collected in the heart.
Meditating on Him, this desire is quenched.
Meditating on Him, one is approved in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
Meditating on Him, millions of mistakes are erased.
Meditating on Him, one becomes Holy, blessed by the Lord.
Meditating on Him, the mind is cooled and soothed.
Meditating on Him, all filth is washed away. ||4||
Meditating on Him, the jewel of the Lord is obtained.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: bahur na chhoddai har sa(n)g hilai ||
verses.translation: One is reconciled with the Lord, and shall not abandon Him again.
Meditating on Him, many acquire a home in the heavens.
Meditating on Him, one abides in intuitive peace. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਇਹ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਪੋਹਤ ॥
verses.translit: jaas japat ieh agan na pohat ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, one is not affected by this fire.

verses.original: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਇਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹਤ ॥
verses.translit: jaas japat ih kaal na johat ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, one is not under the gaze of Death.
Meditating on Him, your forehead shall be immaculate.
Meditating on Him, all pains are destroyed. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaas japat musakal kachhoo na banai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, no difficulties are encountered.
Meditating on Him, one hears the unstruck melody.
Meditating on Him, one acquires this pure reputation.
Meditating on Him, the heart-lotus is turned upright. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur subh dhirasaT sabh uoopar karee ||
verses.translation: The Guru has bestowed His Glance of Grace upon all,

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis kai hiradhai ma(n)tr dhe haree ||
verses.translation: within whose hearts the Lord has implanted His Mantra.
The unbroken Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is their food and nourishment.
Says Nanak, they have the Perfect True Guru. ||8||2||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh ridh a(n)tar dhaarai ||
verses.translation: Those who implant the Word of the Guru's Shabad within their hearts
cut their connections with the five passions.
They keep the ten organs under their control;
their souls are enlightened. ||1||
They alone acquire such stability,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau dhiaa miaa prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: whom God blesses with His Mercy and Grace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: saajan dhusaT jaa kai ek samaanai ||
verses.translation: Friend and foe are one and the same to them.
Whatever they speak is wisdom.
Whatever they hear is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Whatever they see is meditation. ||2||
They awaken in peace and poise; they sleep in peace and poise.
That which is meant to be, automatically happens.
In peace and poise, they remain detached; in peace and poise, they laugh.
In peace and poise, they remain silent; in peace and poise, they chant. ||3||
In peace and poise they eat; in peace and poise they love.
The illusion of duality is easily and totally removed.
They naturally join the Saadh Sangat, the Society of the Holy.
In peace and poise, they meet and merge with the Supreme Lord God. ||4||
They are at peace in their homes, and they are at peace while detached.
